instance ToBSON Spine.WallLifecycleChange where
  toBSON change =
    case change of
      Spine.WallStarted band presence ->
        [ "_co" =: ("WallStarted" :: String),
          "band" =: band,
          "presence" =: presence
        ]
      Spine.WallBandUpdated band presence ->
        [ "_co" =: ("WallBandUpdated" :: String),
          "band" =: band,
          "presence" =: presence
        ]
      Spine.WallPresenceChanged band presence ->
        [ "_co" =: ("WallPresenceChanged" :: String),
          "band" =: band,
          "presence" =: presence
        ]
      Spine.WallEnded reason ->
        [ "_co" =: ("WallEnded" :: String),
          "reason" =: reason
        ]

instance FromBSON Spine.WallLifecycleChange where
  fromBSON document = do
    constructor <- BSON.lookup "_co" document :: Maybe String
    case constructor of
      "WallStarted" ->
        Spine.WallStarted
          <$> BSON.lookup "band" document
          <*> BSON.lookup "presence" document
      "WallBandUpdated" ->
        Spine.WallBandUpdated
          <$> BSON.lookup "band" document
          <*> BSON.lookup "presence" document
      "WallPresenceChanged" ->
        Spine.WallPresenceChanged
          <$> BSON.lookup "band" document
          <*> BSON.lookup "presence" document
      "WallEnded" -> Spine.WallEnded <$> BSON.lookup "reason" document
      _ -> Nothing

dumpWallOutputs :: (Fao owner) => owner -> WallLifecycleOutputs -> FaoModel ()
dumpWallOutputs owner outputs = withEventDump owner $ do
  dumpAdtEvent' "wall_occurrences" (WallOccurrenceBatch <$> wallLifecycleOccurrences outputs)
  dumpAdtEvent' "wall_current_view" (WallCurrentBatch <$> wallLifecycleCurrentUpdates outputs)
  dumpAdtEvent' "wall_diagnostics" (WallDiagnostic <$> wallLifecycleDiagnostics outputs)

data WallLifecycleError
  = WallOccurrenceRefConflict OccurrenceRef
  | WallStartedTwice WallIdentity
  | WallMustStartPresent WallIdentity
  | WallUpdateBeforeStart WallIdentity
  | WallUpdateAfterEnd WallIdentity
  | WallEndBeforeStart WallIdentity
  | WallBandUpdateChangedPresence WallIdentity WallBusinessState Spine.WallPresence
  | WallInvalidPresenceTransition WallIdentity WallBusinessState Spine.WallPresence
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show, Generic)

data WallLifecycleState = WallLifecycleState
  { wallLedger :: OccurrenceLedger OccurrenceRef,
    wallViews :: Map WallIdentity WallCurrentView,
    wallCurrentUpdateBatch :: Map WallIdentity WallCurrentView
  }
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show, Generic)

emptyWallLifecycleState :: WallLifecycleState
emptyWallLifecycleState = WallLifecycleState emptyOccurrenceLedger Map.empty Map.empty

validateWallTransition :: WallIdentity -> Maybe WallCurrentView -> Spine.WallLifecycleChange -> Either WallLifecycleError WallBusinessState
validateWallTransition identity before change = case (before, change) of
  (Nothing, Spine.WallStarted _ Spine.WallAlive) -> Right WallPresent
  (Nothing, Spine.WallStarted _ Spine.WallDormant) -> Left (WallMustStartPresent identity)
  (Nothing, Spine.WallEnded _) -> Left (WallEndBeforeStart identity)
  (Nothing, _) -> Left (WallUpdateBeforeStart identity)
  (Just _, Spine.WallStarted _ _) -> Left (WallStartedTwice identity)
  (Just current, _)
    | wallCurrentState current == WallEndedState -> Left (WallUpdateAfterEnd identity)
  (Just current, Spine.WallBandUpdated _ presence) -> case (wallCurrentState current, presence) of
    (WallPresent, Spine.WallAlive) -> Right WallPresent
    (WallDormantState, Spine.WallDormant) -> Right WallDormantState
    _ -> Left (WallBandUpdateChangedPresence identity (wallCurrentState current) presence)
  (Just current, Spine.WallPresenceChanged _ presence) -> case (wallCurrentState current, presence) of
    (WallPresent, Spine.WallDormant) -> Right WallDormantState
    (WallDormantState, Spine.WallAlive) -> Right WallPresent
    _ -> Left (WallInvalidPresenceTransition identity (wallCurrentState current) presence)
  (Just _, Spine.WallEnded _) -> Right WallEndedState

applyWallOccurrence :: WallLifecycleState -> WallLifecycleOccurrence -> Either WallLifecycleError (WallLifecycleState, Maybe WallLifecycleOccurrence)
applyWallOccurrence state occurrence = do
  let ref = wallOccurrenceRef occurrence
      identity = wallOccurrenceIdentity occurrence
      change = Spine.wallLifecycleChange (wallOccurrencePayload occurrence)
  case appendOccurrence ref occurrence (wallLedger state) of
    (_, OccurrenceRefConflict) -> Left (WallOccurrenceRefConflict ref)
    (_, OccurrenceAlreadyPresent) -> Right (state, Nothing)
    (nextLedger, OccurrenceAppended) -> do
      let before = Map.lookup identity (wallViews state)
      afterState <- validateWallTransition identity before change
      let current = WallCurrentView identity afterState occurrence
          nextViews =
            case afterState of
              WallEndedState -> Map.delete identity (wallViews state)
              _ -> Map.insert identity current (wallViews state)
          next =
            state
              { wallLedger = nextLedger,
                wallViews = nextViews,
                wallCurrentUpdateBatch = Map.insert identity current (wallCurrentUpdateBatch state)
              }
      Right (next, Just occurrence)

applyWallOccurrenceBatch :: WallLifecycleState -> [WallLifecycleOccurrence] -> Either WallLifecycleError (WallLifecycleState, [WallLifecycleOccurrence])
applyWallOccurrenceBatch initial occurrences = do
  -- occurrence_ref 的唯一性由已提交 artifact 保证；运行态只检查当前
  -- firing，不能再永久镜像全年 occurrence fingerprint。
  let firingState = initial {wallLedger = emptyOccurrenceLedger, wallCurrentUpdateBatch = Map.empty}
  (next, publishedReversed) <- foldM step (firingState, []) occurrences
  pure (next, reverse publishedReversed)
  where
    step (state, published) occurrence = do
      (next, accepted) <- applyWallOccurrence state occurrence
      pure (next, maybe published (: published) accepted)

data WallLifecycleOutputs = WallLifecycleOutputs
  { wallLifecycleOccurrences :: FrpEvent [WallLifecycleOccurrence],
    wallLifecycleCurrent :: FrpDynamic (Map WallIdentity WallCurrentView),
    wallLifecycleCurrentUpdates :: FrpEvent [WallCurrentView],
    wallLifecycleDiagnostics :: FrpEvent (P1ProductDiagnostics WallLifecycleError)
  }

data WallTxn = WallTxn
  { wallTxnState :: WallLifecycleState,
    wallTxnResult :: Maybe (Either WallLifecycleError [WallLifecycleOccurrence])
  }

stepWall :: [WallLifecycleOccurrence] -> WallTxn -> WallTxn
stepWall occurrences txn = case applyWallOccurrenceBatch (wallTxnState txn) occurrences of
  Left err -> txn {wallTxnResult = Just (Left err)}
  Right (next, published) -> WallTxn next (Just (Right published))

wallCurrentUpdatesFor :: WallLifecycleState -> [WallCurrentView]
wallCurrentUpdatesFor = Map.elems . wallCurrentUpdateBatch

data WallLifecycleP = WallLifecycleP

instance CEPS WallLifecycleP FaoModel where
  type Input WallLifecycleP = FrpEvent [WallLifecycleOccurrence]
  type Output WallLifecycleP = WallLifecycleOutputs

  processEvents WallLifecycleP input = do
    transactions <- foldDyn stepWall (WallTxn emptyWallLifecycleState Nothing) input
    let outcomes = fmapMaybe wallTxnResult (updated transactions)
        acceptedTransactions =
          fmapMaybe
            (\txn -> case wallTxnResult txn of
                Just (Right published) | not (null published) -> Just (txn, published)
                _ -> Nothing
            )
            (updated transactions)
    current <- holdDyn Map.empty (wallViews . wallTxnState . fst <$> acceptedTransactions)
    pure
      WallLifecycleOutputs
        { wallLifecycleOccurrences = snd <$> acceptedTransactions,
          wallLifecycleCurrent = current,
          wallLifecycleCurrentUpdates =
            (\(txn, _published) -> wallCurrentUpdatesFor (wallTxnState txn))
              <$> acceptedTransactions,
          wallLifecycleDiagnostics =
            (\err -> P1ProductDiagnostics [] [err])
              <$> fmapMaybe (either Just (const Nothing)) outcomes
        }

maintainWallLifecycle :: FrpEvent [WallLifecycleOccurrence] -> FaoModel WallLifecycleOutputs
maintainWallLifecycle = processEvents WallLifecycleP

expectedUpstreamKinds "wall_relation_barrier" = Set.singleton "wall_lifecycle"

validateReceiptKind :: Text -> ProductReceipt -> Either Text ProductReceipt
validateReceiptKind expected receipt
  | expected `Set.notMember` knownProductKinds = Left "unknown P1 product kind"
  | receiptProductKind receipt /= expected = Left "P1 thin receipt product kind mismatch"
  | receiptSchemaVersion receipt /= expectedSchemaVersion expected = Left "P1 thin receipt schema version mismatch"
  | receiptStatus receipt /= "success" = Left "P1 thin receipt is not successful"
  | any Text.null requiredText = Left "P1 thin receipt contains an empty required field"
  | actualKinds /= expectedUpstreamKinds expected = Left "P1 thin receipt direct upstream products mismatch"
  | (expected == "attack_segment" || expected == "attack_formation_evidence")
      && null [() | item <- receiptDirectUpstreamArtifacts receipt, upstreamProductKind item == "directed_large_deal_stream"] =
      Left "Attack product must name at least one selected F4 artifact"
  | otherwise = Right receipt
  where
    scope = receiptSourceScope receipt
    requiredText :: [Text]
    requiredText =
      [ receiptFeatureInstance receipt,
        receiptParameterSetId receipt,
        sourceTarget scope,
        sourceCalendarOrSession scope,
        sourceTimeRange scope,
        sourceMarketCut scope,
        receiptSchemaVersion receipt,
        receiptCodeVersion receipt,
        receiptArtifactLocation receipt
      ]
    actualKinds = Set.fromList (fmap upstreamProductKind (receiptDirectUpstreamArtifacts receipt))

  { eligibleWallDistanceTicks :: Int,
    segmentContinuationGapTicks :: Int,
    selectedF4Streams :: [FeatureRunIdentity],

    laneMergePolicy :: Text,
    methodSnapshotFingerprint :: Text
  }
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show, Generic)

lookupObject :: Text -> Value -> Maybe Value
lookupObject key (Object values) = KeyMap.lookup (Key.fromText key) values
lookupObject _ _ = Nothing

valueText :: Text -> Value -> Maybe Text
valueText key value = case lookupObject key value of
  Just (String item) -> Just item
  _ -> Nothing

valueInt :: Text -> Value -> Maybe Int
valueInt key value = case lookupObject key value of
  Just (Number item) -> Just (round item)
  _ -> Nothing

receiptBusinessParameterText :: Text -> ProductReceipt -> Maybe Text
receiptBusinessParameterText key = valueText key . receiptActualBusinessParameters

selectedIdentity :: Value -> Maybe FeatureRunIdentity
selectedIdentity value = do
  feature <- valueText "feature_instance" value
  parameter <- valueText "parameter_set_id" value
  artifact <- valueText "artifact_location" value
  schema <- valueText "schema_version" value
  code <- valueText "code_version" value
  scopeValue <- lookupObject "source_scope" value
  scope <- case fromJSON scopeValue of Success parsed -> Just parsed; Error _ -> Nothing
  pure (featureRunIdentityFromFaoContext (ProductReceipt "directed_large_deal_stream" feature parameter scope (object []) (object []) [] Nothing schema code artifact "success" Nothing))

attackFormationMethodSnapshotFromReceipt :: ProductReceipt -> Either Text AttackFormationMethodSnapshot
attackFormationMethodSnapshotFromReceipt receipt = do
  distance <- maybe (Left "Attack receipt misses eligible_wall_distance_ticks") Right (valueInt "p_attack_ticks" params)
  gap <- maybe (Left "Attack receipt misses segment_continuation_gap_ticks") Right (valueInt "t_gap_attack_ticks" params)
  selected <- case lookupObject "selected_f4_streams" params of
    Just (Array values) -> traverse (maybe (Left "Attack selected F4 identity is incomplete") Right . selectedIdentity) (foldr (:) [] values)
    _ -> Left "Attack receipt misses selected_f4_streams"
  producerLanePolicy <- maybe (Left "Attack receipt misses lane_merge_policy") Right (valueText "lane_merge_policy" params)
  lanePolicy <-
    if producerLanePolicy == "union_keep_labels"
      then Right "attack-segment-local-union-keep-labels"
      else Left "Attack receipt lane_merge_policy is not the frozen local union policy"
  fingerprintValue <- maybe (Left "Attack receipt misses method_snapshot_fingerprint") Right (receiptMethodSnapshotFingerprint receipt)
  if null selected
    then Left "Attack receipt selected_f4_streams is empty"
    else
      Right
        ( AttackFormationMethodSnapshot
            distance
            gap
            selected
            (fmap parameterSetId selected)
            lanePolicy
            fingerprintValue
        )
  where
    params = receiptActualBusinessParameters receipt

-- | EC-SAME-BEST-DIRECTION-MEASUREMENT。0 分母只能进入 NotApplicable。
data SameBestDirectionMeasurement
  = SameBestDirectionAvailable Quantity Quantity
  | SameBestDirectionNotApplicable
  | SameBestDirectionUnavailable Text
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show, Generic)

mkSameBestAvailable :: Quantity -> Quantity -> Either Text SameBestDirectionMeasurement
mkSameBestAvailable numerator@(Quantity numeratorValue) denominator@(Quantity denominatorValue)
  | any
      (\value -> isNaN value || isInfinite value)
      ([numeratorValue, denominatorValue] :: [Double]) =
      Left "same-best quantities must be finite"
  | numeratorValue < 0 = Left "same-best numerator must be non-negative"
  | denominatorValue <= 0 =
      Left "non-positive same-best denominator is not applicable, not available"
  | otherwise = Right (SameBestDirectionAvailable numerator denominator)

mkSameBestNotApplicable :: SameBestDirectionMeasurement
mkSameBestNotApplicable = SameBestDirectionNotApplicable

sameBestNumerator :: SameBestDirectionMeasurement -> Maybe Quantity
sameBestNumerator measurement =
  case measurement of
    SameBestDirectionAvailable numerator _ -> Just numerator
    _ -> Nothing

sameBestDenominator :: SameBestDirectionMeasurement -> Maybe Quantity
sameBestDenominator measurement =
  case measurement of
    SameBestDirectionAvailable _ denominator -> Just denominator
    SameBestDirectionNotApplicable -> Just (Quantity 0)
    SameBestDirectionUnavailable _ -> Nothing

sameBestUnavailableReason :: SameBestDirectionMeasurement -> Maybe Text
sameBestUnavailableReason measurement =
  case measurement of
    SameBestDirectionUnavailable reason -> Just reason
    _ -> Nothing

-- | 非空、去重且保留业务发生顺序的集合。与基于 Ord 的 NonEmptySet 不同，
-- 该类型不会把 append-only occurrence lineage 重排成字典序。
newtype NonEmptyOrderedSet a = NonEmptyOrderedSet [a]
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show, Generic)

nonEmptyOrderedSetFromList :: (Eq a) => [a] -> Either Text (NonEmptyOrderedSet a)
nonEmptyOrderedSetFromList [] = Left "ordered set must be non-empty"
nonEmptyOrderedSetFromList values
  | length values /= length (deduplicate values) =
      Left "ordered set values must be unique"
  | otherwise = Right (NonEmptyOrderedSet values)
  where
    deduplicate = foldl addIfMissing []
    addIfMissing seen value
      | value `elem` seen = seen
      | otherwise = seen ++ [value]

nonEmptyOrderedSetToList :: NonEmptyOrderedSet a -> [a]
nonEmptyOrderedSetToList (NonEmptyOrderedSet values) = values

appendNonEmptyOrderedSet :: (Eq a) => NonEmptyOrderedSet a -> a -> NonEmptyOrderedSet a
appendNonEmptyOrderedSet ordered@(NonEmptyOrderedSet values) value
  | value `elem` values = ordered
  | otherwise = NonEmptyOrderedSet (values ++ [value])

  Maybe JudgementRef ->
  ContributionEligibility ->
  SourceAvailability ->
  EvidenceUse
mkEvidenceUse source role sourceTime absorbedBy eligibility availability =
  EvidenceUse
    { evidenceUseSource = source,
      evidenceUseSourceKind = evidenceSourceKind source,
      evidenceUseRole = role,
      evidenceUseSourceTime = sourceTime,
      evidenceUseAbsorbedBy = absorbedBy,
      evidenceUseContributionEligibility = eligibility,
      evidenceUseAvailability = availability
    }

data CanonicalPair a = CanonicalPair a a
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show, Generic)

mkCanonicalPair :: (Ord a) => a -> a -> Either Text (CanonicalPair a)
mkCanonicalPair left right
  | left == right = Left "a canonical pair requires two distinct members"
  | left < right = Right (CanonicalPair left right)
  | otherwise = Right (CanonicalPair right left)

canonicalPairMembers :: CanonicalPair a -> (a, a)
canonicalPairMembers (CanonicalPair left right) = (left, right)

newtype NonEmptySet a = NonEmptySet (Set a)
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show, Generic)

nonEmptySetFromList :: (Ord a) => [a] -> Either Text (NonEmptySet a)
nonEmptySetFromList values =
  let members = Set.fromList values
   in if Set.null members
        then Left "NonEmptySet cannot be empty"
        else Right (NonEmptySet members)

nonEmptySetToList :: NonEmptySet a -> [a]
nonEmptySetToList (NonEmptySet members) = Set.toAscList members

-- | Tick的统一时间轴下标(uti = unified timeline index)
type TickUTI = Int

-- | 具有Tick的统一时间轴下标(uti = unified timeline index)的类型类
class HasTickUTI a where 
    atTickUTI :: a -> TickUTI

instance HasTickUTI TickUTI where 
    atTickUTI = id

instance (HasTickUTI a, HasTickUTI b) => HasTickUTI (These a b) where 
    atTickUTI (This x) = atTickUTI x 
    atTickUTI (That y) = atTickUTI y 
    atTickUTI (These x y) = maximum ([atTickUTI x, atTickUTI y] :: [TickUTI])

instance (HasTickUTI a) => (HasTickUTI (Tick a)) where 
    atTickUTI tick = atTickUTI (atTickValue tick :: a)

-- | 获取给定交易日历与绝对路径以及品种的统一时间轴(utl = unified timeline)的Tick数据作为Vector
--
-- 用于获得连续主力合约、指数的Tick数据
--
-- 获取除了时间以外的数据, 请使用 utlGetTickV @Double, 获取时间数据, 请使用 utlGetTickV @Word64
--
-- 注意截止到20241030, 指数的Tick数据还没有存成dba, 不能用这个函数加载, 如有需要, 要提出来处理
utlGetSymTickVWith :: forall a m.(Eq a, Storable a, EdhXchg a, Typeable a, MonadIO m) 
    => 
    CalendarName -- ^ 交易日历
    -> FilePath -- ^ 数据的绝对路径
    -> Sym -- ^ 品种
    -> UTLTickDataSpec 
    -> m (UTLTickDataVector a)
utlGetSymTickVWith calendarName absPath sym spec = let 
    (path, fileName) = case spec of 
        SubContinuousContract fieldName -> (
            constructTickDataPath subContinuousContractRelPath
            , toSubContinuousContractFileName fieldName)
        OriginalIndexData fieldName -> (
            constructTickDataPath originalIndexDataRelPath
            , toOriginalIndexDataFileName fieldName)
    in liftIO $ readDbaAsVector path fileName
  where 
    subContinuousContractRelPath = "sub_continuous_contract/dba"
    originalIndexDataRelPath = "original_market/index"
    calendarStr = getCalendarString sym calendarName
    symDir = T.unpack sym <> "_" <> calendarStr
    constructTickDataPath relPath = absPath <> "/" <> relPath <> "/" <> symDir

-- | CSV行数据结构，用于解析CSV文件
data CsvFuturesRow = CsvFuturesRow
  { csvSymbol :: T.Text,
    csvDate :: T.Text,
    csvOfferPrecision :: Int,
    csvMinimalChanges :: Double,
    csvPointOfValue :: Double,

  } deriving (Show, Generic)

instance Csv.FromNamedRecord CsvFuturesRow where
  parseNamedRecord r = CsvFuturesRow
    <$> r Csv..: "Symbol"
    <*> r Csv..: "date"
    <*> r Csv..: "offer_precision"
    <*> r Csv..: "minimal_changes"
    <*> r Csv..: "point_of_value"
    <*> r Csv..: "trading_unit"

-- | 解析日期范围，提取开始日期并设置为早上8点
-- 输入格式：2013/01/01-2013/06/25 或 2019/12/10-
-- 输出：2013/01/01 08:00:00 对应的Timestamp（不考虑时区）
parseDateRange :: T.Text -> Maybe Timestamp
parseDateRange dateRange = do
  let startDateText = T.takeWhile (/= '-') dateRange
  -- 解析日期格式 YYYY/MM/DD
  day <- parseTimeM True defaultTimeLocale "%Y/%m/%d" (T.unpack startDateText)
  -- 设置时间为早上8点，直接作为UTCTime处理，不考虑时区
  let timeOfDay = TimeOfDay 8 0 0
      diffTime = timeOfDayToTime timeOfDay
      utcTime = UTCTime day diffTime
  return $ convert utcTime

-- | 从CSV文件解析期货合约历史数据
parseFuturesContractFromCsv :: BL.ByteString -> Either String FuturesContractHistoryData
parseFuturesContractFromCsv csvData = do
  csvRows <- Csv.decodeByName csvData
  let rows = V.toList (snd csvRows)
  
  -- 解析每行数据，提取时间戳和合约规格
  let parsedRows = [(ts, row) | row <- rows, Just ts <- [parseDateRange (csvDate row)]]
  
  if null parsedRows
    then Left "No valid rows found in CSV"
    else do
      let (timestamps, csvRows') = unzip parsedRows
          tsVector = VS.fromList timestamps
          minimalChangesVector = VS.fromList $ map csvMinimalChanges csvRows'
          pointOfValueVector = VS.fromList $ map csvPointOfValue csvRows'
          tradingUnitVector = VS.fromList $ map csvTradingUnit csvRows'
      
      return $ FuturesContractHistoryData
        { _ts = tsVector
        , _minimalChanges = minimalChangesVector
        , _pointOfValue = pointOfValueVector
        , _tradingUnit = tradingUnitVector
        }

-- * 日历相关

-- | 根据品种以及日历名, 获取对应的日历字符串. 
-- 日历如果用四个品种共有的日历, 则日历字符串就是convert的结果. 如果用品种自己的日历, 则日历字符串就是品种名.
getCalendarString :: Sym -> CalendarName -> String
getCalendarString sym AtSelfCalendar = T.unpack sym
getCalendarString _ calendarName = T.unpack $ convert calendarName

-- | 品种以及其合理的日历
data SymbolAffiliatedCalendars = SymbolAffiliatedCalendars
  { symbol :: T.Text
  , affiliatedCalendars :: T.Text
  } deriving Show

-- 定义CSV的Parser
instance Csv.FromRecord SymbolAffiliatedCalendars where
  parseRecord v
    | length v == 2 = SymbolAffiliatedCalendars <$> v Csv..! 0 <*> v Csv..! 1
    | otherwise = mzero

-- | 读取品种以及其合理的日历
readSymbolAffiliatedCalendars :: FilePath -> IO (M.Map Sym (S.Set CalendarName))
readSymbolAffiliatedCalendars filePath = do
  csvData <- BL.readFile filePath
  let decoded = Csv.decode Csv.HasHeader csvData :: Either String (Vector SymbolAffiliatedCalendars)
  case decoded of
    Left err -> error err
    Right rows -> return $ M.fromList $ map parseRow (toList rows)
  where
    -- 解析单个行数据，将字符串转为列表
    parseRow :: SymbolAffiliatedCalendars -> (Sym, S.Set CalendarName)
    parseRow (SymbolAffiliatedCalendars symbol calendar) = (symbol, S.fromList (parseCalendars calendar))
    -- 解析字符串格式的Calendar
    parseCalendars :: T.Text -> [CalendarName]
    parseCalendars calendar = map 
        (f . removeQuotes . T.strip) (T.splitOn "," (T.dropAround (== '[') (T.dropAround (== ']') calendar)))
      where 
        f calendar_string = case calendar_string of 
            "no_night" -> NoNight
            "night_end_at_2300" -> NightEndAt2300
            "night_end_at_0100" -> NightEndAt0100
            "night_end_at_0230" -> NightEndAt0230
            _ -> AtSelfCalendar
        removeQuotes t
          | T.head t == '\'' && T.last t == '\'' = T.drop 1 (T.dropEnd 1 t)
          | otherwise = t

-- | 获得各个品种合理的日历
getAllAffiliatedCalendars :: (MonadIO m) => m (M.Map Sym (S.Set CalendarName))
getAllAffiliatedCalendars = liftIO $ do
  -- 允许运行环境指定当前数据源的日历归属文件。
  calendarCsv <- maybe "/m3varI/var/L1_data/sof/unit/affiliated_calendar_no_night.csv" id
    <$> lookupEnv "MQUANT_AFFILIATED_CALENDAR_CSV"
  readSymbolAffiliatedCalendars calendarCsv

-- | 当前品种的合理日历
currentSymbolCalendars :: FaoModel (S.Set CalendarName)
currentSymbolCalendars = do
    symbol <- currentSymbol
    M.findWithDefault S.empty symbol <$> getAllAffiliatedCalendars

-- | 特征涉及到的品种以及其合理的日历
getSymbolAffiliatedCalendars :: (Fao f) => f -> FaoModel (M.Map Sym (S.Set CalendarName))
getSymbolAffiliatedCalendars f = do
    symbols <- getSymbols f
    M.filterWithKey (\k _ -> k `S.member` S.fromList symbols) <$> getAllAffiliatedCalendars

-- | 仅供 P1 DSU 内部使用的 append-only occurrence ledger。
module Frp.Instance.ISL.Eaw.P1.Internal.OccurrenceLedger
  ( OccurrenceLedger,
    AppendDisposition (..),
    emptyOccurrenceLedger,
    appendOccurrence,
  )
where

import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import Data.Map.Strict qualified as Map
import Data.Text (Text)
import Data.Text qualified as Text
import Frp.Apt (encodeSha1)
import GHC.Generics (Generic)

-- | DSU 的 append-only occurrence 已由正式事件流和 writer 保存；运行态
-- ledger 只承担 exact duplicate／conflicting duplicate 判定，不能再复制
-- 一份完整 payload 历史。
newtype OccurrenceLedger ref = OccurrenceLedger
  { ledgerFingerprintByRef :: Map ref Text
  }
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show, Generic)

-- | 一条 occurrence 对运行态幂等索引造成的结果。
data AppendDisposition
  = OccurrenceAppended
  | OccurrenceAlreadyPresent
  | OccurrenceRefConflict
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show, Generic)

-- | 空的运行态幂等索引。
emptyOccurrenceLedger :: OccurrenceLedger ref
emptyOccurrenceLedger = OccurrenceLedger Map.empty

-- | 按 occurrence 引用登记 payload fingerprint。
--
-- 输入依次是业务 occurrence 引用、完整业务 payload 和当前幂等索引；输出
-- 是更新后的紧凑索引以及追加／重复／冲突判定。fingerprint 只用于本次运行
-- 内的幂等判断，不成为业务身份，也不替代正式 writer 中的完整 occurrence。
appendOccurrence :: (Ord ref, Show payload) => ref -> payload -> OccurrenceLedger ref -> (OccurrenceLedger ref, AppendDisposition)
appendOccurrence ref payload ledger =
  case Map.lookup ref (ledgerFingerprintByRef ledger) of
    Nothing ->
      ( ledger
          { ledgerFingerprintByRef = Map.insert ref fingerprint (ledgerFingerprintByRef ledger)
          },
        OccurrenceAppended
      )
    Just existing
      | existing == fingerprint -> (ledger, OccurrenceAlreadyPresent)
      | otherwise -> (ledger, OccurrenceRefConflict)
  where
    fingerprint = Text.pack (encodeSha1 (show payload))

    emptyBuildActivityState,
    applyBuildFrame,
    maintainBuildActivity,
  )
where

import Control.Monad (foldM)
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import Data.Map.Strict qualified as Map
import Frp.Apt (FrpDynamic, FrpEvent)
import Frp.CEP.Class (CEPS (..))
import Frp.Core (FaoModel)
import Frp.Instance.ISL.Eaw.Interface.PreL0 qualified as Spine
import Frp.Instance.ISL.Eaw.P1.Internal.OccurrenceLedger
import Frp.Instance.ISL.Eaw.P1.Products
import GHC.Generics (Generic)
import Reflex (fmapMaybe, foldDyn, holdDyn, updated)

data BuildActivityError
  = BuildOccurrenceRefConflict OccurrenceRef
  | BuildUnknownWall WallIdentity
  | BuildStartedTwice BuildActivityIdentity
  | BuildUpdateBeforeStart BuildActivityIdentity
  | BuildUpdateAfterStop BuildActivityIdentity
  | BuildWallIdentityChanged BuildActivityIdentity WallIdentity WallIdentity
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show, Generic)

data BuildActivityState = BuildActivityState
  { buildWallCatalog :: WallIdentityCatalog,
    buildLedger :: OccurrenceLedger OccurrenceRef,
    buildViews :: Map BuildActivityIdentity BuildCurrentView,
    buildCurrentUpdateBatch :: Map BuildActivityIdentity BuildCurrentView
  }
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show, Generic)

emptyBuildActivityState :: WallIdentityCatalog -> BuildActivityState
emptyBuildActivityState catalog = BuildActivityState catalog emptyOccurrenceLedger Map.empty Map.empty

applyBuildOccurrence :: BuildActivityState -> BuildActivityOccurrence -> Either BuildActivityError (BuildActivityState, Maybe BuildActivityOccurrence)
applyBuildOccurrence state occurrence = do
  let ref = buildOccurrenceRef occurrence
      identity = buildOccurrenceIdentity occurrence
      wallIdentity = buildOccurrenceWallIdentity occurrence
      change = Spine.buildActivityChange (buildOccurrencePayload occurrence)
  if containsWallIdentity wallIdentity (buildWallCatalog state) then pure () else Left (BuildUnknownWall wallIdentity)
  case appendOccurrence ref occurrence (buildLedger state) of
    (_, OccurrenceRefConflict) -> Left (BuildOccurrenceRefConflict ref)
    (_, OccurrenceAlreadyPresent) -> Right (state, Nothing)
    (nextLedger, OccurrenceAppended) -> do
      let before = Map.lookup identity (buildViews state)
      case (before, change) of
        (Nothing, Spine.BuildStarted _) -> pure ()
        (Nothing, _) -> Left (BuildUpdateBeforeStart identity)
        (Just _, Spine.BuildStarted _) -> Left (BuildStartedTwice identity)
        (Just current, _)
          | buildCurrentWallIdentity current /= wallIdentity ->
              Left (BuildWallIdentityChanged identity (buildCurrentWallIdentity current) wallIdentity)
        (Just current, _)
          | buildCurrentState current == BuildStoppedState -> Left (BuildUpdateAfterStop identity)
        _ -> pure ()
      let afterState = case change of Spine.BuildStopped _ _ -> BuildStoppedState; _ -> BuildInProgress
          milestoneIncrement = case change of Spine.BuildReachedMilestone {} -> 1; _ -> 0
          milestoneCount = maybe 0 buildCurrentMilestoneCount before + milestoneIncrement
          current = BuildCurrentView identity wallIdentity afterState milestoneCount occurrence
          nextViews =
            case afterState of
              BuildStoppedState -> Map.delete identity (buildViews state)
              BuildInProgress -> Map.insert identity current (buildViews state)
          next =
            state
              { buildLedger = nextLedger,
                buildViews = nextViews,
                buildCurrentUpdateBatch = Map.insert identity current (buildCurrentUpdateBatch state)
              }
      Right (next, Just occurrence)

applyBuildFrame :: BuildActivityState -> [BuildActivityOccurrence] -> Either BuildActivityError (BuildActivityState, [BuildActivityOccurrence])
applyBuildFrame initial occurrences = do
  -- committed artifact 负责全局 occurrence_ref 唯一；这里只保留当前 firing
  -- 的重复／冲突检查和本次 current 更新。
  let firingState = initial {buildLedger = emptyOccurrenceLedger, buildCurrentUpdateBatch = Map.empty}
  (next, publishedReversed) <- foldM step (firingState, []) occurrences
  pure (next, reverse publishedReversed)
  where
    step (state, published) occurrence = do
      (next, accepted) <- applyBuildOccurrence state occurrence
      pure (next, maybe published (: published) accepted)

data BuildActivityOutputs = BuildActivityOutputs
  { buildActivityOccurrences :: FrpEvent [BuildActivityOccurrence],
    buildActivityCurrent :: FrpDynamic (Map BuildActivityIdentity BuildCurrentView),
    buildActivityCurrentUpdates :: FrpEvent [BuildCurrentView],
    buildActivityDiagnostics :: FrpEvent (P1ProductDiagnostics BuildActivityError)
  }

data BuildTxn = BuildTxn
  { buildTxnState :: BuildActivityState,
    buildTxnResult :: Maybe (Either BuildActivityError [BuildActivityOccurrence])
  }

stepBuild :: [BuildActivityOccurrence] -> BuildTxn -> BuildTxn
stepBuild occurrences txn = case applyBuildFrame (buildTxnState txn) occurrences of
  Left err -> txn {buildTxnResult = Just (Left err)}
  Right (next, published) -> BuildTxn next (Just (Right published))

buildCurrentUpdatesFor :: BuildActivityState -> [BuildCurrentView]
buildCurrentUpdatesFor = Map.elems . buildCurrentUpdateBatch

newtype BuildActivityP = BuildActivityP WallIdentityCatalog

instance CEPS BuildActivityP FaoModel where
  type Input BuildActivityP = FrpEvent [BuildActivityOccurrence]
  type Output BuildActivityP = BuildActivityOutputs

  processEvents (BuildActivityP catalog) input = do
    transactions <- foldDyn stepBuild (BuildTxn (emptyBuildActivityState catalog) Nothing) input
    let outcomes = fmapMaybe buildTxnResult (updated transactions)
        acceptedTransactions =
          fmapMaybe
            (\txn -> case buildTxnResult txn of
                Just (Right published) | not (null published) -> Just (txn, published)
                _ -> Nothing
            )
            (updated transactions)
    current <- holdDyn Map.empty (buildViews . buildTxnState . fst <$> acceptedTransactions)
    pure
      BuildActivityOutputs
        { buildActivityOccurrences = snd <$> acceptedTransactions,
          buildActivityCurrent = current,
          buildActivityCurrentUpdates =
            (\(txn, _published) -> buildCurrentUpdatesFor (buildTxnState txn))
              <$> acceptedTransactions,
          buildActivityDiagnostics =
            (\err -> P1ProductDiagnostics [] [err])
              <$> fmapMaybe (either Just (const Nothing)) outcomes
        }

maintainBuildActivity :: WallIdentityCatalog -> FrpEvent [BuildActivityOccurrence] -> FaoModel BuildActivityOutputs
maintainBuildActivity catalog = processEvents (BuildActivityP catalog)

module Frp.Instance.ISL.Eaw.P1.AttackSegmentBook
  ( AttackSegmentBookP (..),
    AttackIngressEvents (..),
    AttackSegmentBookState,
    AttackSegmentBookError (..),
    AttackSegmentBookOutputs (..),
    emptyAttackSegmentBookState,
    currentAttackSegmentBookView,
    applyAttackFrame,
    maintainAttackSegmentBook,
  )
where

import Control.Monad (foldM)
import Data.List (sortOn)
import Data.Map.Strict qualified as Map
import Frp.Apt (FrpDynamic, FrpEvent)
import Frp.CEP.Class (CEPS (..))
import Frp.Core (FaoModel)
import Frp.Instance.ISL.Eaw.P1.Internal.OccurrenceLedger
import Frp.Instance.ISL.Eaw.P1.Products
import GHC.Generics (Generic)
import Reflex (fmapMaybe, foldDyn, holdDyn, mergeWith, updated)

data AttackBookOccurrence
  = AttackBookSegment AttackSegmentAtWall
  | AttackBookFormation AttackFormationMaterialOccurrence
  | AttackBookBarrier WallAttackBarrierOccurrence
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show, Generic)

attackBookRef :: AttackBookOccurrence -> OccurrenceRef
attackBookRef (AttackBookSegment value) = attackOccurrenceRef value
attackBookRef (AttackBookFormation value) = formationOccurrenceRef value
attackBookRef (AttackBookBarrier value) = barrierOccurrenceRef value

attackBookWallIdentity :: AttackBookOccurrence -> WallIdentity
attackBookWallIdentity (AttackBookSegment value) = attackOccurrenceWallIdentity value
attackBookWallIdentity (AttackBookFormation value) = formationOccurrenceWallIdentity value
attackBookWallIdentity (AttackBookBarrier value) = barrierOccurrenceWallIdentity value

data AttackSegmentBookError
  = AttackOccurrenceRefConflict OccurrenceRef
  | AttackUnknownWall WallIdentity
  | AttackSegmentIdentityConflict AttackSegmentIdentity
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show, Generic)

data AttackSegmentBookState = AttackSegmentBookState
  { attackWallCatalog :: WallIdentityCatalog,
    attackLedger :: OccurrenceLedger OccurrenceRef,
    attackBookView :: AttackSegmentBookCurrentView
  }
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show, Generic)

emptyAttackSegmentBookState :: WallIdentityCatalog -> AttackSegmentBookState
emptyAttackSegmentBookState catalog =
  AttackSegmentBookState catalog emptyOccurrenceLedger emptyAttackSegmentBookCurrentView

-- | 读取当前已形成段。FormationEvidence 与 formal Barrier 只写 occurrence
-- 历史，不复制进 current view。
-- 输入是本次运行的段簿状态，输出是其当前正式业务投影。
currentAttackSegmentBookView :: AttackSegmentBookState -> AttackSegmentBookCurrentView
currentAttackSegmentBookView = attackBookView

applyAttackOccurrence :: AttackSegmentBookState -> AttackBookOccurrence -> Either AttackSegmentBookError (AttackSegmentBookState, Maybe AttackBookOccurrence)
applyAttackOccurrence state occurrence = do
  let ref = attackBookRef occurrence
      wallIdentity = attackBookWallIdentity occurrence
      before = attackBookView state
  if containsWallIdentity wallIdentity (attackWallCatalog state) then pure () else Left (AttackUnknownWall wallIdentity)
  case appendOccurrence ref occurrence (attackLedger state) of
    (_, OccurrenceRefConflict) -> Left (AttackOccurrenceRefConflict ref)
    (_, OccurrenceAlreadyPresent) -> Right (state, Nothing)
    (nextLedger, OccurrenceAppended) -> do
      after <- case occurrence of
        AttackBookSegment segment ->
          let identity = attackOccurrenceIdentity segment
           in case Map.lookup identity (attackCurrentSegments before) of
                Nothing -> Right (recordFormedAttackSegment segment before)
                Just existing | existing == segment -> Right before
                Just _ -> Left (AttackSegmentIdentityConflict identity)
        AttackBookFormation _formation -> Right before
        AttackBookBarrier _barrier -> Right before
      Right (state {attackLedger = nextLedger, attackBookView = after}, Just occurrence)

data AttackFrameOutput = AttackFrameOutput
  { frameSegments :: [AttackSegmentAtWall],
    frameFormations :: [AttackFormationMaterialOccurrence],
    frameBarriers :: [WallAttackBarrierOccurrence]
  }

emptyAttackFrameOutput :: AttackFrameOutput
emptyAttackFrameOutput = AttackFrameOutput [] [] []

attackFrameOutputIsEmpty :: AttackFrameOutput -> Bool
attackFrameOutputIsEmpty output =
  null (frameSegments output)
    && null (frameFormations output)
    && null (frameBarriers output)

nonEmpty :: [value] -> Maybe [value]
nonEmpty [] = Nothing
nonEmpty values = Just values

applyAttackFrame :: AttackSegmentBookState -> [AttackSegmentAtWall] -> [AttackFormationMaterialOccurrence] -> [WallAttackBarrierOccurrence] -> Either AttackSegmentBookError (AttackSegmentBookState, AttackFrameOutput)
applyAttackFrame initial segments formations barriers = do
  -- Segment／Formation／Barrier 已由 P1 artifact 完整保存。生产 DSU 只对
  -- 当前 firing 做 typed validation 与重复检查；current view 也只投影本次
  -- firing，不能把同一份全年稀疏历史再次常驻进 Map。
  let firingState =
        initial
          { attackLedger = emptyOccurrenceLedger,
            attackBookView = emptyAttackSegmentBookCurrentView
          }
  (next, reversedOutput) <- foldM step (firingState, emptyAttackFrameOutput) ordered
  pure
    ( next,
      AttackFrameOutput
        { frameSegments = reverse (frameSegments reversedOutput),
          frameFormations = reverse (frameFormations reversedOutput),
          frameBarriers = reverse (frameBarriers reversedOutput)
        }
    )
  where
    ordered =
      fmap AttackBookSegment (sortOn attackOccurrenceRef segments)
        <> fmap AttackBookFormation (sortOn formationOccurrenceRef formations)
        <> fmap AttackBookBarrier (sortOn barrierOccurrenceRef barriers)
    step (state, output) occurrence = do
      (next, accepted) <- applyAttackOccurrence state occurrence
      case accepted of
        Nothing -> pure (next, output)
        Just (AttackBookSegment value) -> pure (next, output {frameSegments = value : frameSegments output})
        Just (AttackBookFormation value) -> pure (next, output {frameFormations = value : frameFormations output})
        Just (AttackBookBarrier value) -> pure (next, output {frameBarriers = value : frameBarriers output})

data AttackIngressEvents = AttackIngressEvents
  { attackIngressSegments :: FrpEvent [AttackSegmentAtWall],
    attackIngressFormations :: FrpEvent [AttackFormationMaterialOccurrence],
    attackIngressBarriers :: FrpEvent [WallAttackBarrierOccurrence]
  }

data AttackSegmentBookOutputs = AttackSegmentBookOutputs
  { attackSegmentsAtWall :: FrpEvent [AttackSegmentAtWall],
    attackFormationMaterials :: FrpEvent [AttackFormationMaterialOccurrence],
    wallAttackBarriers :: FrpEvent [WallAttackBarrierOccurrence],
    attackSegmentBookCurrent :: FrpDynamic AttackSegmentBookCurrentView,
    attackSegmentBookDiagnostics :: FrpEvent (P1ProductDiagnostics AttackSegmentBookError)
  }

data AttackCommand
  = AddAttackSegments [AttackSegmentAtWall]
  | AddAttackFormations [AttackFormationMaterialOccurrence]
  | AddAttackBarriers [WallAttackBarrierOccurrence]

data AttackTxn = AttackTxn
  { attackTxnState :: AttackSegmentBookState,
    attackTxnResult :: Maybe (Either AttackSegmentBookError AttackFrameOutput)
  }

stepAttack :: [AttackCommand] -> AttackTxn -> AttackTxn
stepAttack commands txn =
  let segments = concat [values | AddAttackSegments values <- commands]
      formations = concat [values | AddAttackFormations values <- commands]
      barriers = concat [values | AddAttackBarriers values <- commands]
   in case applyAttackFrame (attackTxnState txn) segments formations barriers of
        Left err -> txn {attackTxnResult = Just (Left err)}
        Right (next, output) -> AttackTxn next (Just (Right output))

newtype AttackSegmentBookP = AttackSegmentBookP WallIdentityCatalog

instance CEPS AttackSegmentBookP FaoModel where
  type Input AttackSegmentBookP = AttackIngressEvents
  type Output AttackSegmentBookP = AttackSegmentBookOutputs

  processEvents (AttackSegmentBookP catalog) input = do
    let commands =
          mergeWith
            (<>)
            [ (\values -> [AddAttackSegments values]) <$> attackIngressSegments input,
              (\values -> [AddAttackFormations values]) <$> attackIngressFormations input,
              (\values -> [AddAttackBarriers values]) <$> attackIngressBarriers input
            ]
    transactions <- foldDyn stepAttack (AttackTxn (emptyAttackSegmentBookState catalog) Nothing) commands
    let outcomes = fmapMaybe attackTxnResult (updated transactions)
        acceptedTransactions =
          fmapMaybe
            ( \txn -> case attackTxnResult txn of
                Just (Right output) | not (attackFrameOutputIsEmpty output) -> Just (txn, output)
                _ -> Nothing
            )
            (updated transactions)
        accepted = snd <$> acceptedTransactions
    current <- holdDyn (attackBookView (emptyAttackSegmentBookState catalog)) (attackBookView . attackTxnState . fst <$> acceptedTransactions)
    pure
      AttackSegmentBookOutputs
        { attackSegmentsAtWall = fmapMaybe (nonEmpty . frameSegments) accepted,
          attackFormationMaterials = fmapMaybe (nonEmpty . frameFormations) accepted,
          wallAttackBarriers = fmapMaybe (nonEmpty . frameBarriers) accepted,
          attackSegmentBookCurrent = current,
          attackSegmentBookDiagnostics =
            (\err -> P1ProductDiagnostics [] [err])
              <$> fmapMaybe (either Just (const Nothing)) outcomes
        }

maintainAttackSegmentBook :: WallIdentityCatalog -> FrpEvent [AttackSegmentAtWall] -> FrpEvent [AttackFormationMaterialOccurrence] -> FrpEvent [WallAttackBarrierOccurrence] -> FaoModel AttackSegmentBookOutputs
maintainAttackSegmentBook catalog segments formations barriers =
  processEvents (AttackSegmentBookP catalog) (AttackIngressEvents segments formations barriers)

module Frp.Instance.ISL.Eaw.P1.AbsorbInteraction
  ( AbsorbInteractionP (..),
    AbsorbInteractionState,
    AbsorbInteractionError (..),
    AbsorbInteractionOutputs (..),
    emptyAbsorbInteractionState,
    applyAbsorbFrame,
    maintainAbsorbInteractions,
  )
where

import Control.Monad (foldM)
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import Data.Map.Strict qualified as Map
import Frp.Apt (FrpDynamic, FrpEvent)
import Frp.CEP.Class (CEPS (..))
import Frp.Core (FaoModel)
import Frp.Instance.ISL.Eaw.Interface.PreL0 qualified as Spine
import Frp.Instance.ISL.Eaw.P1.Internal.OccurrenceLedger
import Frp.Instance.ISL.Eaw.P1.Products
import GHC.Generics (Generic)
import Reflex (fmapMaybe, foldDyn, holdDyn, updated)

data AbsorbInteractionError
  = AbsorbOccurrenceRefConflict OccurrenceRef
  | AbsorbUnknownWall WallIdentity
  | AbsorbStartedTwice AbsorbInteractionIdentity
  | AbsorbUpdateBeforeStart AbsorbInteractionIdentity
  | AbsorbUpdateAfterResolution AbsorbInteractionIdentity
  | AbsorbWallIdentityChanged AbsorbInteractionIdentity WallIdentity WallIdentity
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show, Generic)

data AbsorbInteractionState = AbsorbInteractionState
  { absorbWallCatalog :: WallIdentityCatalog,
    absorbLedger :: OccurrenceLedger OccurrenceRef,
    absorbViews :: Map AbsorbInteractionIdentity AbsorbCurrentView,
    absorbCurrentUpdateBatch :: Map AbsorbInteractionIdentity AbsorbCurrentView
  }
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show, Generic)

emptyAbsorbInteractionState :: WallIdentityCatalog -> AbsorbInteractionState
emptyAbsorbInteractionState catalog = AbsorbInteractionState catalog emptyOccurrenceLedger Map.empty Map.empty

applyAbsorbOccurrence :: AbsorbInteractionState -> AbsorbInteractionOccurrence -> Either AbsorbInteractionError (AbsorbInteractionState, Maybe AbsorbInteractionOccurrence)
applyAbsorbOccurrence state occurrence = do
  let ref = absorbOccurrenceRef occurrence
      identity = absorbOccurrenceIdentity occurrence
      wallIdentity = absorbOccurrenceWallIdentity occurrence
      change = Spine.absorbInteractionChange (absorbOccurrencePayload occurrence)
  if containsWallIdentity wallIdentity (absorbWallCatalog state) then pure () else Left (AbsorbUnknownWall wallIdentity)
  case appendOccurrence ref occurrence (absorbLedger state) of
    (_, OccurrenceRefConflict) -> Left (AbsorbOccurrenceRefConflict ref)
    (_, OccurrenceAlreadyPresent) -> Right (state, Nothing)
    (nextLedger, OccurrenceAppended) -> do
      let before = Map.lookup identity (absorbViews state)
      case (before, change) of
        (Nothing, Spine.AbsorbInteractionStarted _) -> pure ()
        (Nothing, _) -> Left (AbsorbUpdateBeforeStart identity)
        (Just _, Spine.AbsorbInteractionStarted _) -> Left (AbsorbStartedTwice identity)
        (Just current, _)
          | absorbCurrentWallIdentity current /= wallIdentity ->
              Left (AbsorbWallIdentityChanged identity (absorbCurrentWallIdentity current) wallIdentity)
        (Just current, _)
          | absorbCurrentState current == AbsorbResolvedState -> Left (AbsorbUpdateAfterResolution identity)
        _ -> pure ()
      let afterState = case change of Spine.AbsorbInteractionResolved _ _ -> AbsorbResolvedState; _ -> AbsorbInProgress
          milestoneIncrement = case change of Spine.AbsorbConsumptionMilestone _ -> 1; _ -> 0
          milestoneCount = maybe 0 absorbCurrentMilestoneCount before + milestoneIncrement
          current = AbsorbCurrentView identity wallIdentity afterState milestoneCount occurrence
          nextViews =
            case afterState of
              AbsorbResolvedState -> Map.delete identity (absorbViews state)
              AbsorbInProgress -> Map.insert identity current (absorbViews state)
          next =
            state
              { absorbLedger = nextLedger,
                absorbViews = nextViews,
                absorbCurrentUpdateBatch = Map.insert identity current (absorbCurrentUpdateBatch state)
              }
      Right (next, Just occurrence)

applyAbsorbFrame :: AbsorbInteractionState -> [AbsorbInteractionOccurrence] -> Either AbsorbInteractionError (AbsorbInteractionState, [AbsorbInteractionOccurrence])
applyAbsorbFrame initial occurrences = do
  -- committed artifact 负责全局 occurrence_ref 唯一；这里只保留当前 firing
  -- 的重复／冲突检查和本次 current 更新。
  let firingState = initial {absorbLedger = emptyOccurrenceLedger, absorbCurrentUpdateBatch = Map.empty}
  (next, publishedReversed) <- foldM step (firingState, []) occurrences
  pure (next, reverse publishedReversed)
  where
    step (state, published) occurrence = do
      (next, accepted) <- applyAbsorbOccurrence state occurrence
      pure (next, maybe published (: published) accepted)

data AbsorbInteractionOutputs = AbsorbInteractionOutputs
  { absorbInteractionOccurrences :: FrpEvent [AbsorbInteractionOccurrence],
    absorbInteractionCurrent :: FrpDynamic (Map AbsorbInteractionIdentity AbsorbCurrentView),
    absorbInteractionCurrentUpdates :: FrpEvent [AbsorbCurrentView],
    absorbInteractionDiagnostics :: FrpEvent (P1ProductDiagnostics AbsorbInteractionError)
  }

data AbsorbTxn = AbsorbTxn
  { absorbTxnState :: AbsorbInteractionState,
    absorbTxnResult :: Maybe (Either AbsorbInteractionError [AbsorbInteractionOccurrence])
  }

stepAbsorb :: [AbsorbInteractionOccurrence] -> AbsorbTxn -> AbsorbTxn
stepAbsorb occurrences txn = case applyAbsorbFrame (absorbTxnState txn) occurrences of
  Left err -> txn {absorbTxnResult = Just (Left err)}
  Right (next, published) -> AbsorbTxn next (Just (Right published))

absorbCurrentUpdatesFor :: AbsorbInteractionState -> [AbsorbCurrentView]
absorbCurrentUpdatesFor = Map.elems . absorbCurrentUpdateBatch

newtype AbsorbInteractionP = AbsorbInteractionP WallIdentityCatalog

instance CEPS AbsorbInteractionP FaoModel where
  type Input AbsorbInteractionP = FrpEvent [AbsorbInteractionOccurrence]
  type Output AbsorbInteractionP = AbsorbInteractionOutputs

  processEvents (AbsorbInteractionP catalog) input = do
    transactions <- foldDyn stepAbsorb (AbsorbTxn (emptyAbsorbInteractionState catalog) Nothing) input
    let outcomes = fmapMaybe absorbTxnResult (updated transactions)
        acceptedTransactions =
          fmapMaybe
            (\txn -> case absorbTxnResult txn of
                Just (Right published) | not (null published) -> Just (txn, published)
                _ -> Nothing
            )
            (updated transactions)
    current <- holdDyn Map.empty (absorbViews . absorbTxnState . fst <$> acceptedTransactions)
    pure
      AbsorbInteractionOutputs
        { absorbInteractionOccurrences = snd <$> acceptedTransactions,
          absorbInteractionCurrent = current,
          absorbInteractionCurrentUpdates =
            (\(txn, _published) -> absorbCurrentUpdatesFor (absorbTxnState txn))
              <$> acceptedTransactions,
          absorbInteractionDiagnostics =
            (\err -> P1ProductDiagnostics [] [err])
              <$> fmapMaybe (either Just (const Nothing)) outcomes
        }

maintainAbsorbInteractions :: WallIdentityCatalog -> FrpEvent [AbsorbInteractionOccurrence] -> FaoModel AbsorbInteractionOutputs
maintainAbsorbInteractions catalog = processEvents (AbsorbInteractionP catalog)

mergeIngressDiagnostics :: [FrpEvent [P1IngressError]] -> FrpEvent (P1ProductDiagnostics productError) -> FrpEvent (P1ProductDiagnostics productError)
mergeIngressDiagnostics ingress stateDiagnostics =
  mergeWith
    (\left right -> mergeP1ProductDiagnostics [left, right])
    ( ((\event -> (\errors -> P1ProductDiagnostics errors []) <$> event) <$> ingress)
        <> [stateDiagnostics]
    )

doWallLifecycleFrp :: EawP1WallLifecycleFrp -> FaoModel WallLifecycleOutputs
doWallLifecycleFrp feature = do
  ingress <- wallOccurrenceIngress (wallLifecycleInput feature)
  outputs <- maintainWallLifecycle (ingressOccurrences ingress)
  pure
    outputs
      { wallLifecycleDiagnostics =
          mergeIngressDiagnostics [ingressDiagnostics ingress] (wallLifecycleDiagnostics outputs)
      }

          mergeIngressDiagnostics [ingressDiagnostics ingress] (buildActivityDiagnostics outputs)
      }

type NumericRow = Map Text Double

-- | P1 的 Python DBA 一行就是一条业务 occurrence。平台通用
-- 'genericLoad' 会把一行的每个数值字段分别注册成历史事件；对宽 occurrence
-- 表会按字段数放大底层事件。这里仍读取同一份 fields.json／DBA 文件，但
-- 每个 result key 只注册一条行事件，列只在该行触发时组装成 NumericRow。
data PackedNumericRowsHistoryData = PackedNumericRowsHistoryData
  { packedRowTimestamps :: VS.Vector Timestamp,
    packedRowColumns :: Map Text (VS.Vector Double)
  }

instance HasFrpHistoryTs PackedNumericRowsHistoryData where
  atHistoryTs = packedRowTimestamps

instance HasFrpHistoryData PackedNumericRowsHistoryData NumericRow where
  lookupHistoryData PackedNumericRowsHistoryData {..} index =
    ( packedRowTimestamps VS.! index,
      Map.map (VS.! index) packedRowColumns,
      Nothing
    )

loadPackedNumericRows :: FilePath -> Text -> Map Text Text -> IO PackedNumericRowsHistoryData
loadPackedNumericRows fullDir resultKey fields = do
  timestamps <-
    loadBitsDba @Word64 (fullDir </> Text.unpack (resultKey <> ".__ts__") <.> "dba")
      <&> VS.map convert
  columns <-
    Map.traverseWithKey
      (\field dtype -> readDbaAsVectorDouble fullDir (Text.unpack resultKey <> "." <> Text.unpack field) dtype)
      fields
  let expected = VS.length timestamps
  forM_ (Map.toList columns) $ \(field, values) ->
    unless (VS.length values == expected) $
      error
        ( "P1 packed occurrence row length mismatch: "
            <> Text.unpack resultKey
            <> "."
            <> Text.unpack field
            <> " has "
            <> show (VS.length values)
            <> " values but "
            <> show expected
            <> " timestamps"
        )
  pure (PackedNumericRowsHistoryData timestamps columns)

data P1DecodedIngress value = P1DecodedIngress
  { ingressOccurrences :: FrpEvent [value],
    ingressDiagnostics :: FrpEvent [P1IngressError]
  }

partitionIngressBatch :: [Either P1IngressError value] -> (Maybe [value], Maybe [P1IngressError])
partitionIngressBatch values =
  case partitionEithers values of
    ([], accepted) -> (nonEmpty accepted, Nothing)
    (diagnostics, _rejectedWholeBatch) -> (Nothing, nonEmpty diagnostics)
  where
    nonEmpty items = if null items then Nothing else Just items

readThinProductReceipt :: FilePath -> Text -> IO (Either Text ProductReceipt)
readThinProductReceipt fullDir kind = do
  let receiptPath = fullDir <> "/p1_receipts/" <> Text.unpack kind <> ".json"
  receiptExists <- doesFileExist receiptPath
  if not receiptExists
    then pure (Left ("P1 thin receipt sidecar is missing: " <> kind))
    else do
      receiptResult <- eitherDecodeFileStrict' receiptPath
      pure $ do
        receipt <- either (Left . Text.pack) Right receiptResult
        validateReceiptKind kind receipt

loadProductReceiptFrom :: PyAny -> Text -> FaoModel ProductReceipt
loadProductReceiptFrom source kind = do
  fullDir <- getFullDir source
  result <- liftIO (readThinProductReceipt fullDir kind)
  receipt <- either (error . Text.unpack) pure result
  when
    (normalise (Text.unpack (receiptArtifactLocation receipt)) /= normalise fullDir)
    (error ("P1 thin receipt artifact_location 与实际 Fao source 不一致: " <> fullDir))
  pure receipt

loadGenericArtifact :: (HasHisBack) => PyAny -> Text -> FaoModel GenericFaoResult
loadGenericArtifact source kind = do
  loaded <- genericLoad source
  case loaded of
    Nothing -> do
      fullDir <- getFullDir source
      error (Text.unpack kind <> " requires a committed DBA artifact: " <> fullDir)
    Just generic -> pure generic

loadGenericProduct :: (HasHisBack) => PyAny -> Text -> FaoModel GenericFaoResult
loadGenericProduct source kind = do
  _ <- loadProductReceiptFrom source kind
  loadGenericArtifact source kind

loadPackedProductMetadata :: PyAny -> [Text] -> FaoModel (FilePath, Map Text (Map Text Text))
loadPackedProductMetadata source prefixes = do
  fullDir <- getFullDir source
  metadata <- liftIO (loadFieldDtypes fullDir)
  fields <- maybe (error ("P1 packed occurrence fields.json is missing: " <> fullDir)) pure metadata
  let selected =
        Map.mapMaybe
          ( \case
              FDtypeMapJson nested -> Just nested
              FDtypeTextJson _ -> Nothing
          )
          (Map.filterWithKey (\key _ -> any (`Text.isPrefixOf` key) prefixes) fields)
  when (Map.null selected) $
    error
      ( "P1 packed occurrence product has no matching result key in "
          <> fullDir
          <> ": "
          <> show prefixes
      )
  pure (fullDir, selected)

-- | 同一物理行的全部字段只形成一条历史事件，避免按宽表字段数放大事件数。
loadPackedProductRows :: PyAny -> [Text] -> FaoModel (FrpEvent [(Text, NumericRow)])
loadPackedProductRows source prefixes = do
  (fullDir, groups) <- loadPackedProductMetadata source prefixes
  target <- getTarName source
  events <-
    forM (Map.toList groups) $ \(resultKey, fields) -> do
      let ?hisBack = BackNumber 0
      event <-
        lift $
          newAdtFrpEvent4His @PackedNumericRowsHistoryData @NumericRow
            (packEventName source target ("__eaw_occurrence_row__." <> resultKey))
            (BackNumber 0)
            (loadPackedNumericRows fullDir resultKey fields)
      pure ((\tick -> [(resultKey, atTickValue tick)]) <$> event)
  pure (mergeWith (<>) events)

groupResultKeyFields :: GenericFaoResult -> Map Text GenericFaoResult
groupResultKeyFields = Map.foldrWithKey addField Map.empty
  where
    addField fullName stream groups =
      let (resultKey, suffix) = Text.breakOn "." fullName
       in if Text.null resultKey || Text.null suffix
            then groups
            else Map.insertWith Map.union resultKey (Map.singleton (Text.drop 1 suffix) stream) groups

mergeGenericFaoRows :: GenericFaoResult -> FrpEvent NumericRow
mergeGenericFaoRows fields = Map.map atTickValue <$> mergeMap fields

required :: Text -> NumericRow -> Either P1IngressError Double
required name row = case Map.lookup name row of
  Nothing -> Left (MissingNumericField name)
  Just value -> finiteNumeric name value

finiteNumeric :: Text -> Double -> Either P1IngressError Double
finiteNumeric name value
  | isNaN value || isInfinite value = Left (NonFiniteNumericField name value)
  | otherwise = Right value

integerValue :: Text -> Double -> Either P1IngressError Int
integerValue name raw = do
  value <- finiteNumeric name raw
  let rounded = round value
  if fromIntegral rounded == value
    then Right rounded
    else Left (NonIntegralNumericField name value)

integer :: Text -> NumericRow -> Either P1IngressError Int
integer name row = required name row >>= integerValue name

int64 :: Text -> NumericRow -> Either P1IngressError Int64
int64 name row = fromIntegral <$> integer name row

nonNegative :: Text -> NumericRow -> Either P1IngressError Double
nonNegative name row = do
  value <- required name row
  if value >= 0 then Right value else Left (InvalidNumericDomain name "must be non-negative")

optionalInteger :: Text -> NumericRow -> Either P1IngressError (Maybe Int)
optionalInteger name row = case Map.lookup name row of
  Nothing -> Right Nothing
  Just value
    | isNaN value || isInfinite value -> Right Nothing
    | otherwise -> Just <$> integer name row

readInt64Text :: Text -> Either P1IngressError Int64
readInt64Text value =
  case reads (Text.unpack value) of
    [(parsed, "")] -> Right parsed
    _ -> Left (InvalidResultKey value)

parseObjectKey :: Text -> Text -> Either P1IngressError Int64
parseObjectKey prefix resultKey =
  case Text.splitOn "__" resultKey of
    [actualPrefix, local] | actualPrefix == prefix -> readInt64Text local
    [actualPrefix, local, ordinal]
      | actualPrefix == prefix && "occ" `Text.isPrefixOf` ordinal -> readInt64Text local
    _ -> Left (InvalidResultKey resultKey)

-- | result key 只描述物理承载。旧 fixture 可把 local number 放在 key 中；
-- 正式紧凑流使用 @prefix__stream[@__occNNNN]@，身份必须来自行字段。
parseObjectTransportKey :: Text -> Text -> Either P1IngressError (Maybe Int64)
parseObjectTransportKey prefix resultKey =
  case Text.splitOn "__" resultKey of
    [actualPrefix, "stream"]
      | actualPrefix == prefix -> Right Nothing
    [actualPrefix, "stream", ordinal]
      | actualPrefix == prefix && validOccurrenceOrdinal ordinal -> Right Nothing
    _ -> Just <$> parseObjectKey prefix resultKey

validOccurrenceOrdinal :: Text -> Bool
validOccurrenceOrdinal value =
  case Text.stripPrefix "occ" value of
    Just digits -> not (Text.null digits) && Text.all isDigit digits
    Nothing -> False

positiveLocalNo :: Text -> Int64 -> Either P1IngressError Int64
positiveLocalNo fieldName value =
  if value > 0
    then Right value
    else Left (InvalidNumericDomain fieldName "must be a positive producer-run local number")

objectLocalNoFromRow :: Text -> Text -> Text -> NumericRow -> Either P1IngressError Int64
objectLocalNoFromRow prefix fieldName resultKey row = do
  keyLocalNo <- parseObjectTransportKey prefix resultKey
  rowLocalNo <- case Map.lookup fieldName row of
    Nothing -> case keyLocalNo of
      Just value -> positiveLocalNo fieldName value
      Nothing -> Left (MissingNumericField fieldName)
    Just _ -> int64 fieldName row >>= positiveLocalNo fieldName
  case keyLocalNo of
    Just value
      | value /= rowLocalNo ->
          Left (InvalidNumericDomain fieldName "row local number does not match legacy result key")
    _ -> Right rowLocalNo

loadWallLocalNumbersFromGroup :: FilePath -> (Text, Map Text Text) -> IO (Either P1IngressError (Set.Set Int64))
loadWallLocalNumbersFromGroup fullDir (resultKey, fields) =
  case Map.lookup "wall_id" fields of
    Nothing ->
      pure $ do
        keyLocalNo <- parseObjectTransportKey "wall" resultKey
        case keyLocalNo of
          Just value -> Set.singleton <$> positiveLocalNo "wall_id" value
          Nothing -> Left (MissingNumericField "wall_id")
    Just dtype -> do
      values <- readDbaAsVectorDouble fullDir (Text.unpack resultKey <> ".wall_id") dtype
      pure $ do
        keyLocalNo <- parseObjectTransportKey "wall" resultKey
        VS.foldl'
          ( \acc raw -> do
              localNumbers <- acc
              localNo <- fromIntegral <$> integerValue "wall_id" raw >>= positiveLocalNo "wall_id"
              case keyLocalNo of
                Just expected
                  | expected /= localNo ->
                      Left (InvalidNumericDomain "wall_id" "row local number does not match legacy result key")
                _ -> Right (Set.insert localNo localNumbers)
          )
          (Right Set.empty)
          values

parseRelationKey :: Text -> Text -> Either P1IngressError (Int64, Text)
parseRelationKey prefix resultKey =
  case Text.splitOn "__" resultKey of
    [actualPrefix, wallLocal, direction] | actualPrefix == prefix -> (,direction) <$> readInt64Text wallLocal
    [actualPrefix, wallLocal, direction, ordinal]
      | actualPrefix == prefix && "occ" `Text.isPrefixOf` ordinal -> (,direction) <$> readInt64Text wallLocal
    _ -> Left (InvalidResultKey resultKey)

parseRelationTransportKey :: Text -> Text -> Either P1IngressError (Maybe (Int64, Text))
parseRelationTransportKey prefix resultKey =
  case Text.splitOn "__" resultKey of
    [actualPrefix, "stream"]
      | actualPrefix == prefix -> Right Nothing
    [actualPrefix, "stream", ordinal]
      | actualPrefix == prefix && validOccurrenceOrdinal ordinal -> Right Nothing
    _ -> Just <$> parseRelationKey prefix resultKey

sideName :: Int -> Either P1IngressError Text
sideName 1 = Right "bid"
sideName 2 = Right "ask"
sideName code = Left (UnknownNumericCode "side_code" code)

relationReferenceFromRow :: Text -> Text -> NumericRow -> Either P1IngressError (Int64, Text)
relationReferenceFromRow prefix resultKey row = do
  keyReference <- parseRelationTransportKey prefix resultKey
  wallLocalNo <- case Map.lookup "wall_local_no" row of
    Nothing -> case keyReference of
      Just (value, _) -> positiveLocalNo "wall_local_no" value
      Nothing -> Left (MissingNumericField "wall_local_no")
    Just _ -> int64 "wall_local_no" row >>= positiveLocalNo "wall_local_no"
  directionName <- case Map.lookup "side_code" row of
    Nothing -> case keyReference of
      Just (_, value) | value == "bid" || value == "ask" -> Right value
      Just _ -> Left (InvalidResultKey resultKey)
      Nothing -> Left (MissingNumericField "side_code")
    Just _ -> integer "side_code" row >>= sideName
  case keyReference of
    Just (keyWallLocalNo, keyDirection)
      | keyWallLocalNo /= wallLocalNo || keyDirection /= directionName ->
          Left (InvalidNumericDomain "wall_local_no/side_code" "row relation reference does not match legacy result key")
    _ -> Right (wallLocalNo, directionName)

occurrenceRefFor :: Text -> Int64 -> Int -> Int64 -> OccurrenceRef
occurrenceRefFor productKind localNo uti discriminator =
  OccurrenceRef
    ( productKind
        <> ":"
        <> Text.pack (show localNo)
        <> ":"
        <> Text.pack (show uti)
        <> ":"
        <> Text.pack (show discriminator)
    )

-- | `__occNNNN` 只解决 DBA 同拍物理装箱，不得进入业务 same/new。
transportBaseResultKey :: Text -> Text
transportBaseResultKey resultKey =
  case reverse (Text.splitOn "__" resultKey) of
    ordinal : rest
      | Just digits <- Text.stripPrefix "occ" ordinal,
        not (Text.null digits),
        Text.all isDigit digits,
        not (null rest) ->
          Text.intercalate "__" (reverse rest)
    _ -> resultKey

wallAvailability :: NumericRow -> Either P1IngressError Spine.WallLifecycleAvailability
wallAvailability row =
  integer "availability_code" row >>= \case
    1 -> Right Spine.WallLifecycleAvailable
    2 -> Right Spine.WallLifecycleSourceMissing
    3 -> Right Spine.WallLifecycleStale
    4 -> Right Spine.WallLifecycleSessionInvalid
    5 -> Right Spine.WallLifecycleCalculationUnavailable
    code -> Left (UnknownNumericCode "availability_code" code)

decodeWallNumericRow :: ProductReceipt -> Text -> NumericRow -> Either P1IngressError WallLifecycleOccurrence
decodeWallNumericRow receipt resultKey row = do
  localNo <- objectLocalNoFromRow "wall" "wall_id" resultKey row
  side <- integer "side_code" row >>= wallSide
  occurredAt <- integer "uti" row
  availability <- wallAvailability row
  unless
    (availability == Spine.WallLifecycleAvailable)
    (Left (InvalidNumericDomain "availability_code" "unavailable Wall source is diagnostic-only and cannot drive lifecycle state"))
  eventCode <- integer "event_type_code" row
  change <-
    if eventCode == 7
      then Spine.WallEnded . Spine.WallEndReason . ("producer-reason-code-" <>) . Text.pack . show <$> integer "reason_code" row
      else do
        low <- required "band_lo" row
        high <- required "band_hi" row
        core <- required "core_price" row
        unless (low <= core && core <= high) (Left (InvalidNumericDomain "wall_band" "band_lo <= core_price <= band_hi is required"))
        presence <-
          integer "status_code" row >>= \case
            1 -> Right Spine.WallAlive
            2 -> Right Spine.WallDormant
            code -> Left (UnknownNumericCode "status_code" code)
        let band = Measured (Spine.WallBand (Spine.Price low) (Spine.Price high) (Spine.Price core))
        case eventCode of
          4 -> Right (Spine.WallStarted band presence)
          5 -> Right (Spine.WallBandUpdated band presence)
          6 -> Right (Spine.WallPresenceChanged band presence)
          code -> Left (UnknownNumericCode "event_type_code" code)
  let identity = WallIdentity localNo
      payload =
        Spine.WallLifecycleEvent
          (wallRefOf identity)
          (instrumentFrom receipt)
          side
          occurredAt
          change
          availability
  pure (WallLifecycleOccurrence identity (occurrenceRefFor "wall" localNo occurredAt (fromIntegral eventCode)) payload)

buildAvailability :: NumericRow -> Either P1IngressError Spine.BuildAvailability
buildAvailability row =
  integer "availability_code" row >>= \case
    1 -> Right Spine.BuildAvailable
    2 -> Right Spine.BuildSourceMissing
    3 -> Right Spine.BuildStale
    4 -> Right Spine.BuildSessionInvalid
    5 -> Right Spine.BuildCalculationUnavailable
    code -> Left (UnknownNumericCode "availability_code" code)

decodeBuildNumericRow :: ProductReceipt -> WallIdentityCatalog -> Text -> NumericRow -> Either P1IngressError BuildActivityOccurrence
decodeBuildNumericRow _receipt wallCatalog resultKey row = do
  localNo <- objectLocalNoFromRow "build" "build_id" resultKey row
  wallLocalNo <- int64 "wall_local_no" row
  occurredAt <- integer "uti" row
  availability <- buildAvailability row
  unless
    (availability == Spine.BuildAvailable)
    (Left (InvalidNumericDomain "availability_code" "unavailable Build calculation is diagnostic-only and cannot drive activity state"))
  cumulative <- Spine.Quantity <$> nonNegative "cum_reload_proxy" row
  continuityCode <- integer "same_band_continuity_code" row
  continuity <-
    if continuityCode == 1
      then either (Left . InvalidNumericDomain "same_band_continuity") Right (mkUnitInterval 1)
      else Left (UnknownNumericCode "same_band_continuity_code" continuityCode)
  let measurements = Spine.BuildMeasurements (Measured cumulative) (Measured continuity)
  eventCode <- integer "event_type_code" row
  change <- case eventCode of
    8 -> Right (Spine.BuildStarted measurements)
    9 -> do
      level <- required "level" row
      milestone <- either (Left . InvalidNumericDomain "level") Right (mkUnitInterval level)
      Right (Spine.BuildReachedMilestone (Spine.BuildMilestone (Text.pack (show level))) (Spine.BuildMilestoneRatio milestone) measurements)
    10 -> Right (Spine.BuildStopped (Spine.BuildStopReason "producer-stop") measurements)
    code -> Left (UnknownNumericCode "event_type_code" code)
  wallIdentity <- validateDependentWallIdentity wallLocalNo wallCatalog
  let identity = BuildActivityIdentity localNo
      payload = Spine.BuildActivityEvent (buildRefOf identity) (wallRefOf wallIdentity) occurredAt change availability
  pure (BuildActivityOccurrence identity wallIdentity (occurrenceRefFor "build" localNo occurredAt (fromIntegral eventCode)) payload)

attackLanes :: Int -> Either P1IngressError Spine.AttackLaneQualification
attackLanes 1 = Right Spine.TacticalLaneOnly
attackLanes 2 = Right Spine.StructuralLaneOnly

attackLanes code = Left (UnknownNumericCode "lane_mask" code)

qualifiedUtisFromRows :: Int64 -> [NumericRow] -> Either P1IngressError [Int]
qualifiedUtisFromRows segmentId rows = do
  decoded <- traverse decodeRow rows
  let ordered = sortOn fst decoded
      ordinals = fmap fst ordered
  unless
    (ordinals == [0 .. length ordinals - 1])
    (Left (InvalidNumericDomain "qualified_uti.ordinal" "must start at zero and be contiguous"))
  pure (fmap snd ordered)
  where
    decodeRow row = do
      owner <- int64 "segment_id" row
      unless
        (owner == segmentId)
        (Left (InvalidNumericDomain "qualified_uti.segment_id" "does not match the segment main row"))
      (,) <$> integer "ordinal" row <*> integer "qualified_uti" row

qualificationHitsFromRows :: AttackFormationMethodSnapshot -> Int64 -> [NumericRow] -> Either P1IngressError [F4QualificationHit]
qualificationHitsFromRows snapshot segmentId rows = do
  decoded <- traverse decodeRow rows
  let ordered = sortOn fst decoded
      ordinals = fmap fst ordered
  unless
    (ordinals == [0 .. length ordinals - 1])
    (Left (InvalidNumericDomain "qualification_hit.ordinal" "must start at zero and be contiguous"))
  pure (fmap snd ordered)
  where
    decodeRow row = do
      owner <- int64 "segment_id" row
      unless
        (owner == segmentId)
        (Left (InvalidNumericDomain "qualification_hit.segment_id" "does not match the segment main row"))
      ordinal <- integer "ordinal" row
      streamOrdinal <- integer "selected_stream_ordinal" row
      familyCode <- integer "qualification_family_code" row
      gradeValue <- integer "grade" row
      _ <- case drop streamOrdinal (selectedF4Streams snapshot) of
        _value : _ -> Right ()
        [] -> Left (InvalidNumericDomain "selected_stream_ordinal" "selected F4 stream ordinal is out of range")
      let family = case familyCode of
            1 -> "tactical"
            2 -> "structural"
            _ -> "family-code-" <> Text.pack (show familyCode)
      pure (ordinal, F4QualificationHit streamOrdinal familyCode family gradeValue)

attackSegmentAvailability :: Int -> Either P1IngressError (AttackSegmentAvailability, Maybe Text)
attackSegmentAvailability 1 = Right (AttackSegmentAvailable, Nothing)
attackSegmentAvailability 2 = Right (AttackSegmentTechnicalTruncated, Just "producer-reported-technical-truncation")
attackSegmentAvailability 3 = Right (AttackSegmentUnavailable, Just "producer-reported-unavailable")
attackSegmentAvailability code = Left (UnknownNumericCode "availability_code" code)

-- | 从逐资格族命中形成公共 AttackSegment 中每条 lane 的实际最高档位。
-- 不从旧的合并 max_grade 反推，也不把未参与或不可用编码成零。
laneGradeObservation ::
  Spine.AttackLaneQualification ->
  AttackSegmentAvailability ->
  Int ->
  [F4QualificationHit] ->
  Either P1IngressError Spine.LaneGradeObservation
laneGradeObservation lanes availability familyCode hits
  | not participates && not (null grades) =
      Left (InvalidNumericDomain "qualification_hits" "lane mask excludes a qualification family carried by the segment")
  | not participates = Right Spine.LaneAbsent
  | availability /= AttackSegmentAvailable = Right Spine.LaneUnavailable
  | null grades =
      Left (InvalidNumericDomain "qualification_hits" "lane mask requires a qualification family missing from the segment")
  | any (<= 0) grades =
      Left (InvalidNumericDomain "qualification_hits" "qualification grade must be positive")
  | otherwise =
      Spine.LaneObserved
        <$> either
          (Left . InvalidNumericDomain "qualification_hits")
          Right
          (Spine.mkPositiveGrade (maximum grades))
  where
    grades =
      [ qualificationGrade hit
        | hit <- hits,
          qualificationFamilyCode hit == familyCode
      ]
    participates = case (lanes, familyCode) of
      (Spine.TacticalLaneOnly, 1) -> True
      (Spine.StructuralLaneOnly, 2) -> True
      (Spine.TacticalAndStructuralLanes, 1) -> True
      (Spine.TacticalAndStructuralLanes, 2) -> True
      _ -> False

decodeAttackSegmentNumericRow :: ProductReceipt -> WallIdentityCatalog -> Text -> NumericRow -> [NumericRow] -> [NumericRow] -> Either P1IngressError AttackSegmentAtWall
decodeAttackSegmentNumericRow receipt wallCatalog resultKey row qualifiedRows qualificationHitRows = do
  unless
    (transportBaseResultKey resultKey == "segment__stream")
    (Left (InvalidResultKey resultKey))
  localNo <- int64 "segment_id" row
  when
    (localNo <= 0)
    (Left (InvalidNumericDomain "segment_id" "must be a positive producer-run local number"))
  attemptLocalNo <- int64 "attack_segment_attempt_local_id" row
  when
    (attemptLocalNo <= 0 || attemptLocalNo /= localNo)
    (Left (InvalidNumericDomain "attack_segment_attempt_local_id" "must be positive and equal to segment_id"))
  wallLocalNo <- int64 "wall_local_no" row
  sideCode <- integer "side_code" row
  side <- wallSide sideCode
  direction <- aggressorDirection sideCode
  start <- integer "start_uti" row
  businessEnd <- integer "business_end_uti" row
  closedAt <- integer "closed_at_uti" row
  timeSpan <- either (Left . InvalidNumericDomain "attack_segment_time_span") Right (Spine.mkAttackSegmentTimeSpan start businessEnd closedAt)
  closeCode <- integer "close_reason_code" row
  lanes <- integer "lane_mask" row >>= attackLanes
  count <- integer "hit_occurrence_count_v0" row >>= either (Left . InvalidNumericDomain "hit_occurrence_count_v0") Right . Spine.mkOccurrenceCount
  qualifiedUtis <- qualifiedUtisFromRows localNo qualifiedRows
  expectedCount <- integer "occurrence_utis_count" row
  unless (expectedCount == length qualifiedUtis) (Left (QualifiedUtiCountMismatch expectedCount (length qualifiedUtis)))
  qualified <- case qualifiedUtis of
    [] -> Left (InvalidNumericDomain "qualified_utis" "complete segment requires at least one qualified UTI")
    first : rest -> either (Left . InvalidNumericDomain "qualified_utis") Right (Spine.mkQualifiedOccurrenceUtis (first :| rest))
  amount <- nonNegative "amount_total_v0" row
  maxGrade <- integer "max_grade" row
  entry <- required "entry_price" row
  exitPrice <- required "exit_price" row
  minPrice <- required "min_price" row
  maxPrice <- required "max_price" row
  load <-
    Spine.AttackSegmentLoad count
      <$> (Spine.Quantity <$> nonNegative "directional_hit_volume_proxy_total_v0" row)
      <*> pure (Measured (Spine.Amount amount))
      <*> (Spine.Quantity <$> nonNegative "vol_tactical_overlap_view" row)
      <*> (Spine.Quantity <$> nonNegative "vol_structural_overlap_view" row)
      <*> (Spine.Quantity <$> nonNegative "largest_directional_hit_volume_proxy_v0" row)
      <*> pure (Measured maxGrade)
  pricePath <-
    Spine.AttackSegmentPricePath
      (Measured (Spine.Price entry))
      (Measured (Spine.Price exitPrice))
      (Measured (Spine.Price minPrice))
      (Measured (Spine.Price maxPrice))
      . Measured
      . Spine.TickDistance
      <$> integer "net_progress_ticks" row
      <*> (Measured . Spine.TickDistance <$> integer "max_retreat_from_best_ticks" row)
  proximity <-
    Spine.AttackSegmentProximity
      <$> (Spine.TickDistance <$> integer "max_dist_deal_to_core_ticks" row)
      <*> (Spine.TickDistance <$> integer "last_dist_deal_to_core_ticks" row)
      <*> (Measured . Spine.TickDistance <$> integer "max_wall_core_shift_ticks" row)
  methodSnapshot <- either (const (Left MissingAttackMethodSnapshot)) Right (attackFormationMethodSnapshotFromReceipt receipt)
  qualificationHits <- qualificationHitsFromRows methodSnapshot localNo qualificationHitRows
  when (null qualificationHits) (Left (InvalidNumericDomain "qualification_hits" "complete segment requires selected F4 qualification evidence"))
  when
    (any (\hit -> qualificationFamilyCode hit /= 1 && qualificationFamilyCode hit /= 2) qualificationHits)
    (Left (InvalidNumericDomain "qualification_hits" "only tactical and structural qualification families may enter a canonical AttackSegment"))
  (availability, unavailableReason) <- integer "availability_code" row >>= attackSegmentAvailability
  tacticalGrade <- laneGradeObservation lanes availability 1 qualificationHits
  structuralGrade <- laneGradeObservation lanes availability 2 qualificationHits
  when
    (maxGrade /= maximum (map qualificationGrade qualificationHits))
    (Left (InvalidNumericDomain "max_grade" "diagnostic max_grade does not equal the maximum preserved lane qualification grade"))
  wallIdentity <- validateDependentWallIdentity wallLocalNo wallCatalog
  let identity = AttackSegmentIdentity localNo
      attemptIdentity = AttackSegmentAttemptIdentity attemptLocalNo
      payload =
        Spine.AttackSegmentAtWall
          (attackSegmentRefOf identity)
          (attackSegmentAttemptRefOf attemptIdentity)
          (instrumentFrom receipt)
          (wallRefOf wallIdentity)
          side
          direction
          timeSpan
          (Spine.AttackSegmentCloseReason ("producer-close-code-" <> Text.pack (show closeCode)))
          lanes
          tacticalGrade
          structuralGrade
          load
          pricePath
          proximity
          (Measured qualified)
          Spine.HalfSecondOccurrenceCountV0
          Spine.PredictedDirectionalHitVolumePerHalfSecondV0
  pure
    ( AttackSegmentAtWall
        identity
        wallIdentity
        (occurrenceRefFor "attack-segment" localNo closedAt 5)
        qualificationHits
        availability
        unavailableReason
        payload
    )
