formationInterval :: Int -> Int -> NumericRow -> Either P1IngressError (Int, Int)
formationInterval bodyCode occurredAt row = do
  startValue <- optionalInteger "interval_start_uti" row
  endValue <- optionalInteger "interval_end_uti" row
  (start, end) <- case (startValue, endValue) of
    (Just start, Just end) -> Right (start, end)
    (Nothing, Nothing)
      | bodyCode == 4 || bodyCode == 5 || bodyCode == 6 -> Left (MissingNumericField "interval_start_uti/interval_end_uti")
      | otherwise -> Right (occurredAt, occurredAt)
    _ -> Left (MissingNumericField "interval_start_uti/interval_end_uti")
  unless (start <= end) (Left (InvalidNumericDomain "formation_interval" "start_uti must not follow end_uti"))
  unless (occurredAt == end) (Left (InvalidNumericDomain "formation_interval" "occurrence UTI must equal interval end"))
  Right (start, end)

decodeAttackFormationNumericRow :: ProductReceipt -> WallIdentityCatalog -> Text -> NumericRow -> Either P1IngressError AttackFormationMaterialOccurrence
decodeAttackFormationNumericRow receipt wallCatalog resultKey row = do
  (wallLocalNo, directionName) <- relationReferenceFromRow "formation" resultKey row
  direction <- case directionName of
    "bid" -> Right AggressiveSell
    "ask" -> Right AggressiveBuy
    _ -> Left (InvalidResultKey resultKey)
  occurredAt <- integer "uti" row
  availabilityCode <- integer "availability_code" row
  availability <- formationAvailability availabilityCode
  handoffAvailability <- formationEvidenceAvailability availabilityCode
  sourceLocal <- int64 "source_material_local_ref" row
  localNo <- int64 "formation_local_id" row
  attemptLocalNo <- int64 "attack_segment_attempt_local_id" row
  availableAt <- integer "available_at_uti" row
  reasonCode <- integer "reason_code" row
  bodyCode <- integer "body_kind_code" row
  evidenceKind <- formationEvidenceKind bodyCode availabilityCode
  (intervalStart, intervalEnd) <- formationInterval bodyCode occurredAt row
  when
    (availableAt < intervalEnd)
    (Left (InvalidNumericDomain "available_at_uti" "must not precede the business interval end"))
  let attemptRequired =
        bodyCode == 1
          || bodyCode == 3
          || (bodyCode == 2 && (reasonCode == 3 || reasonCode == 4))
  when
    (attemptRequired && attemptLocalNo <= 0)
    (Left (InvalidNumericDomain "attack_segment_attempt_local_id" "this FormationEvidence must name its AttackSegment attempt"))
  when
    (not attemptRequired && attemptLocalNo /= 0)
    (Left (InvalidNumericDomain "attack_segment_attempt_local_id" "this FormationEvidence must not claim an AttackSegment attempt"))
  wallIdentity <- validateDependentWallIdentity wallLocalNo wallCatalog
  let attemptRef =
        if attemptLocalNo > 0
          then Just (attackSegmentAttemptRefOf (AttackSegmentAttemptIdentity attemptLocalNo))
          else Nothing
      sourceRef = SourceMaterialRef ("p1-formation-source:" <> Text.pack (show sourceLocal))
      reasonText = formationReasonText bodyCode reasonCode availabilityCode
      reason = Spine.AttackFormationReason (fromMaybe ("producer-reason-code-" <> Text.pack (show reasonCode)) reasonText)
  body <- case bodyCode of
    1 -> Right (Spine.AcceptedFormationMaterial (Spine.FormationLargeDealSource (LargeDealEventRef ("f4:" <> Text.pack (show sourceLocal)))))
    2 -> Right (Spine.UnresolvedFormationMaterial reason (Just sourceRef))
    3 -> Right (Spine.MethodLocalGapBreak reason (Just sourceRef))
    4 -> Right (Spine.ObservedNoAcceptedAttackInterval (Spine.AttackFormationReason "observed-no-accepted-attack-interval") (Just sourceRef))
    5 -> Right (Spine.ExcludedFormationMaterial reason (Just sourceRef))
    6 -> Right (Spine.ExcludedFormationMaterial reason (Just sourceRef))
    code -> Left (UnknownNumericCode "body_kind_code" code)
  let material =
        Spine.AttackFormationMaterial
          (AttackFormationScopeRef ("attack-formation:" <> Text.pack (show wallLocalNo)))
          (wallRefOf wallIdentity)
          (instrumentFrom receipt)
          direction
          occurredAt
          availability
          body
      ref = occurrenceRefFor "attack-formation" localNo occurredAt (fromIntegral bodyCode)
  pure
    ( AttackFormationMaterialOccurrence
        wallIdentity
        ref
        attemptRef
        evidenceKind
        intervalStart
        intervalEnd
        availableAt
        handoffAvailability
        reasonText
        material
    )

decodeAbsorbNumericRow :: ProductReceipt -> WallIdentityCatalog -> Text -> NumericRow -> Either P1IngressError AbsorbInteractionOccurrence
decodeAbsorbNumericRow _receipt wallCatalog resultKey row = do
  localNo <- objectLocalNoFromRow "absorb" "track_id" resultKey row
  wallLocalNo <- int64 "wall_local_no" row
  occurredAt <- integer "uti" row
  availability <- absorbAvailability row
  measurements <-
    Spine.AbsorbMeasurements
      <$> (Measured . Spine.Quantity <$> nonNegative "consumed_proxy_cum" row)
      <*> (Measured . Spine.Quantity <$> nonNegative "replenishment_proxy" row)
      <*> (Measured . Spine.TickDistance <$> integer "price_progress_ticks" row)
  eventCode <- integer "event_type_code" row
  (change, occurrenceKind, milestoneLevel, resolvedReason) <- case eventCode of
    11 -> Right (Spine.AbsorbInteractionStarted measurements, AbsorbStartedOccurrence, Nothing, Nothing)
    12 -> do
      level <- required "level" row
      _ <- either (Left . InvalidNumericDomain "level") Right (mkUnitInterval level)
      Right (Spine.AbsorbConsumptionMilestone measurements, AbsorbConsumptionMilestoneOccurrence, Just level, Nothing)
    13 -> do
      resolutionCode <- integer "resolved_type_code" row
      reason <- case resolutionCode of
        1 -> Right "breakthrough"
        2 -> Right "aborted"
        3 -> Right "blocked"
        code -> Left (UnknownNumericCode "resolved_type_code" code)
      Right (Spine.AbsorbInteractionResolved (Spine.AbsorbResolution reason) measurements, AbsorbResolvedOccurrence, Nothing, Just reason)
    code -> Left (UnknownNumericCode "event_type_code" code)
  wallIdentity <- validateDependentWallIdentity wallLocalNo wallCatalog
  let identity = AbsorbInteractionIdentity localNo
      payload = Spine.AbsorbInteractionEvent (absorbRefOf identity) (wallRefOf wallIdentity) occurredAt change availability
  pure
    ( AbsorbInteractionOccurrence
        identity
        wallIdentity
        (occurrenceRefFor "absorb" localNo occurredAt (fromIntegral eventCode))
        occurrenceKind
        milestoneLevel
        resolvedReason
        payload
    )

decodeDirectedLargeDealNumericRow :: ProductReceipt -> Text -> NumericRow -> Either P1IngressError DirectedLargeDealOccurrence
decodeDirectedLargeDealNumericRow receipt resultKey row = do
  localNo <- int64 "producer_local_no" row
  occurredAt <- integer "uti" row
  qualification <- integer "qualification_code" row
  unless (qualification == 1) (Left (InvalidNumericDomain "qualification_code" "quarantine row cannot enter public F4 port"))
  direction <- case head (Text.splitOn "__" resultKey) of
    "buy" -> Right AggressiveBuy
    "sell" -> Right AggressiveSell
    _ -> Left (InvalidResultKey resultKey)
  laneCode <- integer "lane_code" row
  lanes <- attackLanes laneCode
  selectedGrade <- integer "grade" row
  volume <- nonNegative "directional_hit_volume_proxy" row
  amount <- nonNegative "deal_amt" row
  family <- maybe (Left (InvalidNumericDomain "qualification_family" "thin receipt must name the selected family")) Right (receiptBusinessParameterText "qualification_family" receipt)
  familyCode <- integer "qualification_family_code" row
  let expectedFamilyCode
        | family == "tactical" = 1
        | family == "structural" = 2
        | otherwise = 3
  unless (familyCode == expectedFamilyCode && laneCode == expectedFamilyCode) $
    Left (InvalidNumericDomain "qualification_family_code" "row lane/family must match the selected Feature instance")
  let measuredGrade = Measured (Spine.LargeDealLaneGrade (Text.pack (show selectedGrade)))
      unavailableGrade = MeasurementUnavailable "other-qualification-family"
      laneGrades
        | family == "tactical" = Spine.LargeDealLaneQualification lanes measuredGrade unavailableGrade
        | family == "structural" = Spine.LargeDealLaneQualification lanes unavailableGrade measuredGrade
        | otherwise = Spine.LargeDealLaneQualification lanes unavailableGrade unavailableGrade
      ref = occurrenceRefFor "f4" localNo occurredAt (fromIntegral familyCode)
      payload =
        Spine.DirectedLargeDealEvent
          (LargeDealEventRef (unOccurrenceRef ref))
          (instrumentFrom receipt)
          occurredAt
          direction
          laneGrades
          (Spine.Quantity volume)
          (Spine.Amount amount)
          (MethodRef ("f4-method:" <> family))
          Spine.DirectedLargeDealAvailable
  pure (DirectedLargeDealOccurrence localNo ref family selectedGrade payload)

data AttackSegmentTransportKind
  = AttackSegmentMainRow
  | AttackSegmentQualifiedUtiRow
  | AttackSegmentQualificationHitRow
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)

attackSegmentTransportKind :: Text -> Maybe AttackSegmentTransportKind
attackSegmentTransportKind resultKey =
  case transportBaseResultKey resultKey of
    "segment__stream" -> Just AttackSegmentMainRow
    "segment_qualified_uti__stream" -> Just AttackSegmentQualifiedUtiRow
    "segment_qualification_hit__stream" -> Just AttackSegmentQualificationHitRow
    _ -> Nothing

type AttackSegmentTransportBucket = ([(Text, NumericRow)], [NumericRow], [NumericRow])

decodeAttackSegmentTransportBatch :: ProductReceipt -> WallIdentityCatalog -> [(Text, NumericRow)] -> [Either P1IngressError AttackSegmentAtWall]
decodeAttackSegmentTransportBatch receipt wallCatalog transportRows =
  case partitionEithers (fmap classify transportRows) of
    (errors@(_ : _), _) -> fmap Left errors
    ([], classified) -> fmap decodeBucket (Map.toAscList (foldr addRow Map.empty classified))
  where
    classify :: (Text, NumericRow) -> Either P1IngressError (Int64, AttackSegmentTransportKind, Text, NumericRow)
    classify (resultKey, row) = do
      kind <- maybe (Left (InvalidResultKey resultKey)) Right (attackSegmentTransportKind resultKey)
      segmentId <- int64 "segment_id" row
      when
        (segmentId <= 0)
        (Left (InvalidNumericDomain "segment_id" "must be a positive producer-run local number"))
      pure (segmentId, kind, resultKey, row)

    addRow :: (Int64, AttackSegmentTransportKind, Text, NumericRow) -> Map Int64 AttackSegmentTransportBucket -> Map Int64 AttackSegmentTransportBucket
    addRow (segmentId, kind, resultKey, row) =
      Map.insertWith mergeBucket segmentId (oneRow kind resultKey row)

    oneRow :: AttackSegmentTransportKind -> Text -> NumericRow -> AttackSegmentTransportBucket
    oneRow AttackSegmentMainRow resultKey row = ([(resultKey, row)], [], [])
    oneRow AttackSegmentQualifiedUtiRow _ row = ([], [row], [])
    oneRow AttackSegmentQualificationHitRow _ row = ([], [], [row])

    mergeBucket :: AttackSegmentTransportBucket -> AttackSegmentTransportBucket -> AttackSegmentTransportBucket
    mergeBucket (newMain, newQualified, newHits) (oldMain, oldQualified, oldHits) =
      (newMain <> oldMain, newQualified <> oldQualified, newHits <> oldHits)

    decodeBucket :: (Int64, AttackSegmentTransportBucket) -> Either P1IngressError AttackSegmentAtWall
    decodeBucket (_segmentId, ([(resultKey, row)], qualifiedRows, qualificationHitRows)) =
      decodeAttackSegmentNumericRow
        receipt
        wallCatalog
        resultKey
        row
        qualifiedRows
        qualificationHitRows
    decodeBucket (segmentId, ([], _, _)) =
      Left
        ( InvalidNumericDomain
            "attack_segment_transport"
            ("segment " <> Text.pack (show segmentId) <> " has detail rows but no main row")
        )
    decodeBucket (segmentId, (_duplicateMainRows, _, _)) =
      Left
        ( InvalidNumericDomain
            "attack_segment_transport"
            ("segment " <> Text.pack (show segmentId) <> " has multiple main rows in one occurrence batch")
        )

decodeAttackSegmentStreamsWithDiagnostics :: ProductReceipt -> WallIdentityCatalog -> GenericFaoResult -> P1DecodedIngress AttackSegmentAtWall
decodeAttackSegmentStreamsWithDiagnostics receipt wallCatalog generic =
  let groups =
        [ (key, fields)
          | (key, fields) <- Map.toList (groupResultKeyFields generic),
            "segment" `Text.isPrefixOf` key
        ]
      streams =
        [ (\row -> [(key, row)]) <$> mergeGenericFaoRows fields
          | (key, fields) <- groups
        ]
      decoded = case streams of
        [] -> never
        _ -> decodeAttackSegmentTransportBatch receipt wallCatalog <$> mergeWith (<>) streams
      accepted = fst . partitionIngressBatch
      rejected = snd . partitionIngressBatch
   in P1DecodedIngress
        { ingressOccurrences = fmapMaybe accepted decoded,
          ingressDiagnostics = fmapMaybe rejected decoded
        }

decodeGroupsWithDiagnostics :: Text -> (Text -> NumericRow -> Either P1IngressError a) -> GenericFaoResult -> P1DecodedIngress a
decodeGroupsWithDiagnostics prefix decoder generic =
  let groups =
        [ (key, fields)
          | (key, fields) <- Map.toList (groupResultKeyFields generic),
            prefix `Text.isPrefixOf` key
        ]
      streams =
        [ (\row -> [decoder key row]) <$> mergeGenericFaoRows fields
          | (key, fields) <- groups
        ]
      decoded = case streams of
        [] -> never
        _ -> mergeWith (<>) streams
      accepted = fst . partitionIngressBatch
      rejected = snd . partitionIngressBatch
   in P1DecodedIngress
        { ingressOccurrences = fmapMaybe accepted decoded,
          ingressDiagnostics = fmapMaybe rejected decoded
        }

decodeGroups :: Text -> (Text -> NumericRow -> Either P1IngressError a) -> GenericFaoResult -> FrpEvent [a]
decodeGroups prefix decoder = ingressOccurrences . decodeGroupsWithDiagnostics prefix decoder

decodePackedRowsWithDiagnostics ::
  (Text -> NumericRow -> Either P1IngressError value) ->
  FrpEvent [(Text, NumericRow)] ->
  P1DecodedIngress value
decodePackedRowsWithDiagnostics decoder rows =
  P1DecodedIngress
    { ingressOccurrences = fmapMaybe (fst . partitionIngressBatch) decoded,
      ingressDiagnostics = fmapMaybe (snd . partitionIngressBatch) decoded
    }
  where
    decoded = fmap (fmap (uncurry decoder)) rows

decodePackedAttackRowsWithDiagnostics ::
  ProductReceipt ->
  WallIdentityCatalog ->
  FrpEvent [(Text, NumericRow)] ->
  P1DecodedIngress AttackSegmentAtWall
decodePackedAttackRowsWithDiagnostics receipt wallCatalog rows =
  P1DecodedIngress
    { ingressOccurrences = fmapMaybe (fst . partitionIngressBatch) decoded,
      ingressDiagnostics = fmapMaybe (snd . partitionIngressBatch) decoded
    }
  where
    decoded = decodeAttackSegmentTransportBatch receipt wallCatalog <$> rows

attackProductIngresses ::
  AttackSegmentFao ->
  FormationEvidenceFao ->
  WallBarrierFao ->
  FaoModel
    ( WallIdentityCatalog,
      P1DecodedIngress AttackSegmentAtWall,
      P1DecodedIngress AttackFormationMaterialOccurrence,
      P1DecodedIngress WallAttackBarrierOccurrence
    )
attackProductIngresses segment formation barrier = do
  segmentReceipt <- loadProductReceiptFrom (attackSegmentSource segment) "attack_segment"
  formationReceipt <- loadProductReceiptFrom (formationEvidenceSource formation) "attack_formation_evidence"
  barrierReceipt <- loadProductReceiptFrom (wallBarrierSource barrier) "wall_relation_barrier"
  either
    (error . show)
    pure
    (validateAttackProductReceiptSet segmentReceipt formationReceipt barrierReceipt)
  segmentWallReceipt <- loadProductReceiptFrom (attackSegmentWallSource segment) "wall_lifecycle"
  formationWallReceipt <- loadProductReceiptFrom (formationEvidenceWallSource formation) "wall_lifecycle"
  barrierWallReceipt <- loadProductReceiptFrom (wallBarrierWallSource barrier) "wall_lifecycle"
  unless
    (segmentWallReceipt == formationWallReceipt && segmentWallReceipt == barrierWallReceipt)
    (error "Attack 三个输入没有指向同一个 exact Wall artifact")
  catalog <-
    loadPackedDependentWallContext segmentReceipt segmentWallReceipt (attackSegmentWallSource segment)
  _ <- either (error . show) pure (validateExactUpstreamReceipt "wall_lifecycle" formationReceipt formationWallReceipt)
  _ <- either (error . show) pure (validateExactUpstreamReceipt "wall_lifecycle" barrierReceipt barrierWallReceipt)
  segmentRows <- loadPackedProductRows (attackSegmentSource segment) ["segment"]
  formationRows <- loadPackedProductRows (formationEvidenceSource formation) ["formation__"]
  barrierRows <- loadPackedProductRows (wallBarrierSource barrier) ["barrier__"]
  pure
    ( catalog,
      decodePackedAttackRowsWithDiagnostics segmentReceipt catalog segmentRows,
      decodePackedRowsWithDiagnostics (decodeAttackFormationNumericRow formationReceipt catalog) formationRows,
      decodePackedRowsWithDiagnostics (decodeWallBarrierNumericRow barrierReceipt catalog) barrierRows
    )

realRunFeatureParametersMustDecode :: IO ()
realRunFeatureParametersMustDecode = do
  let source tag =
        object
          [ "__tag__" .= (tag :: Text.Text),
            "__tar_type__" .= object ["__tag__" .= ("SymbolType" :: Text.Text)],
            "__on_date_range__" .= True
          ]
      wall = source "WallAssembler"
      build = source "BuildAssembler"
      attack = source "AttackFlowAssembler"
      absorb = source "AbsorbAssembler"
      wallParams =
        object
          [ "__tag__" .= ("EawP1WallLifecycleFrp" :: Text.Text),
            "wallLifecycleInput"
              .= object
                [ "__tag__" .= ("WallOccurrenceFao" :: Text.Text),
                  "wallOccurrenceSource" .= wall
                ]
          ]
      buildParams =
        object
          [ "__tag__" .= ("EawP1BuildActivityFrp" :: Text.Text),
            "buildActivityInput"
              .= object
                [ "__tag__" .= ("BuildOccurrenceFao" :: Text.Text),
                  "buildOccurrenceSource" .= build,
                  "buildWallSource" .= wall
                ]
          ]
      attackParams =
        object
          [ "__tag__" .= ("EawP1AttackSegmentBookFrp" :: Text.Text),
            "attackSegmentInput"
              .= object
                [ "__tag__" .= ("AttackSegmentFao" :: Text.Text),
                  "attackSegmentSource" .= attack,
                  "attackSegmentWallSource" .= wall
                ],
            "attackFormationInput"
              .= object
                [ "__tag__" .= ("FormationEvidenceFao" :: Text.Text),
                  "formationEvidenceSource" .= attack,
                  "formationEvidenceWallSource" .= wall
                ],
            "attackBarrierInput"
              .= object
                [ "__tag__" .= ("WallBarrierFao" :: Text.Text),
                  "wallBarrierSource" .= attack,
                  "wallBarrierWallSource" .= wall
                ]
          ]
      absorbParams =
        object
          [ "__tag__" .= ("EawP1AbsorbInteractionFrp" :: Text.Text),
            "absorbInteractionInput"
              .= object
                [ "__tag__" .= ("AbsorbOccurrenceFao" :: Text.Text),
                  "absorbOccurrenceSource" .= absorb,
                  "absorbWallSource" .= wall
                ]
          ]
  requireDecoded "EawP1WallLifecycleFrp" (eitherDecode (encode wallParams) :: Either String EawP1WallLifecycleFrp)
  requireDecoded "EawP1BuildActivityFrp" (eitherDecode (encode buildParams) :: Either String EawP1BuildActivityFrp)

thinReceiptAndStructuredIdentityMustBePreserved :: IO ()
thinReceiptAndStructuredIdentityMustBePreserved = do
  _ <- requireRight "wall receipt" (validateReceiptKind "wall_lifecycle" wallReceipt)
  _ <- requireRight "build receipt" (validateReceiptKind "build_activity" buildReceipt)
  let WallRef exactRef = wallRefOf wallIdentity
  unless (Text.pack (show localNo) `Text.isInfixOf` exactRef) $ fail "WallIdentity 未保留 producer 局部编号"
  unless (targetRef runIdentity == "rb" && timeRangeRef runIdentity == "uti:1..20") $ fail "FeatureRunIdentity 没有保留结构化运行上下文"
  requireLeft "wrong receipt kind" (validateReceiptKind "build_activity" wallReceipt)

thinReceiptSidecarMustNotRequireCommitMarker :: IO ()
thinReceiptSidecarMustNotRequireCommitMarker = do
  temporaryRoot <- getTemporaryDirectory
  (temporaryPath, handle) <- openTempFile temporaryRoot "eaw-p1-v161-receipt"
  hClose handle
  removeFile temporaryPath
  createDirectoryIfMissing True (temporaryPath </> "p1_receipts")
  BL.writeFile (temporaryPath </> "p1_receipts" </> "wall_lifecycle.json") (encode wallReceipt)
  _ <- requireRight "thin receipt without marker" =<< readThinProductReceipt temporaryPath "wall_lifecycle"
  removeDirectoryRecursive temporaryPath

exactWallCatalogMustBeArtifactBasedAndFailClosed :: IO ()
exactWallCatalogMustBeArtifactBasedAndFailClosed = do
  unless (containsWallIdentity wallIdentity wallCatalog) $ fail "exact Wall artifact catalog 未保留 WallIdentity"
  _ <- requireRight "known exact Wall" (validateDependentWallIdentity localNo wallCatalog)
  requireLeft "unknown Wall" (validateDependentWallIdentity (localNo + 1) wallCatalog)
  _ <- requireRight "matching upstream receipt" (validateExactUpstreamReceipt "wall_lifecycle" buildReceipt wallReceipt)
  let otherScope = wallReceipt {receiptSourceScope = scope {sourceMarketCut = "market-cut-B"}}
  requireLeft "mismatched upstream scope" (validateExactUpstreamReceipt "wall_lifecycle" buildReceipt otherScope)

typedIngressMustFailClosedOnMissingOrInvalidFields :: IO ()
typedIngressMustFailClosedOnMissingOrInvalidFields = do
  let row =
        Map.fromList
          [ ("side_code", 1),
            ("uti", 10),
            ("availability_code", 1),
            ("event_type_code", 4),
            ("band_lo", 99),
            ("band_hi", 101),
            ("core_price", 100),
            ("status_code", 1)
          ]
  occurrence <- requireRight "complete Wall numeric row" (decodeWallNumericRow wallReceipt "wall__999" row)
  sameOccurrence <- requireRight "transport-split Wall numeric row" (decodeWallNumericRow wallReceipt "wall__999__occ0001" row)
  unless (wallOccurrenceRef occurrence == wallOccurrenceRef sameOccurrence) $
    fail "transport ordinal 进入了 Wall occurrence identity"
  let compactRow = Map.insert "wall_id" (fromIntegral localNo) row
  compactOccurrence <- requireRight "compact Wall numeric row" (decodeWallNumericRow wallReceipt "wall__stream" compactRow)
  compactSplit <- requireRight "transport-split compact Wall numeric row" (decodeWallNumericRow wallReceipt "wall__stream__occ0001" compactRow)
  unless
    ( wallOccurrenceIdentity compactOccurrence == wallIdentity
        && wallOccurrenceRef compactOccurrence == wallOccurrenceRef compactSplit
    )
    (fail "紧凑 Wall 流没有从行内 wall_id 恢复同一业务 occurrence")
  requireLeft
    "legacy Wall key and row wall_id must agree"
    (decodeWallNumericRow wallReceipt "wall__1000" compactRow)
  requireLeft "missing field must not default to zero" (decodeWallNumericRow wallReceipt "wall__999" (Map.delete "core_price" row))
  requireLeft "invalid Wall band must fail closed" (decodeWallNumericRow wallReceipt "wall__999" (Map.insert "core_price" 102 row))
  requireLeft
    "source-missing Wall row must be diagnostic-only and must not form Wall.End"
    ( decodeWallNumericRow
        wallReceipt
        "wall__999"
        ( Map.insert
            "reason_code"
            1
            (Map.insert "event_type_code" 7 (Map.insert "availability_code" 2 row))
        )
    )
  let unavailableBuildStop =
        Map.fromList
          [ ("wall_local_no", fromIntegral localNo),
            ("uti", 10),
            ("availability_code", 5),
            ("cum_reload_proxy", 0),
            ("same_band_continuity_code", 1),
            ("event_type_code", 10)
          ]
  requireLeft
    "calculation-unavailable Build row must be diagnostic-only and must not form Build.Stop"
    (decodeBuildNumericRow buildReceipt wallCatalog "build__7" unavailableBuildStop)

ingressDiagnosticBatchMustBeAtomic :: IO ()
ingressDiagnosticBatchMustBeAtomic = do
  let row =
        Map.fromList
          [ ("side_code", 1),
            ("uti", 10),
            ("availability_code", 1),
            ("event_type_code", 4),
            ("band_lo", 99),
            ("band_hi", 101),
            ("core_price", 100),
            ("status_code", 1)
          ]
      complete = decodeWallNumericRow wallReceipt "wall__999" row
      invalid = decodeWallNumericRow wallReceipt "wall__1000" (Map.delete "core_price" row)
  case partitionIngressBatch [complete, invalid] of
    (Nothing, Just [MissingNumericField "core_price"]) -> pure ()
    other -> fail ("同拍 ingress 错误没有拒绝整个产品 batch 并形成 diagnostic: " <> show other)

typedF4MustKeepFeatureInstanceFamilyGradeAndLocalIdentity :: IO ()
typedF4MustKeepFeatureInstanceFamilyGradeAndLocalIdentity = do
  let row =
        Map.fromList
          [ ("producer_local_no", fromIntegral localNo),
            ("uti", 10),
            ("qualification_code", 1),
            ("qualification_family_code", 1),
            ("lane_code", 1),
            ("grade", 4),
            ("directional_hit_volume_proxy", 3),
            ("deal_amt", 300)
          ]
  occurrence <- requireRight "typed F4" (decodeDirectedLargeDealNumericRow f4Receipt "buy" row)
  transportSplit <- requireRight "typed F4 transport split" (decodeDirectedLargeDealNumericRow f4Receipt "buy__occ0001" row)
  unless
    ( largeDealOccurrenceLocalNo occurrence == localNo
        && largeDealQualificationFamily occurrence == "tactical"
        && largeDealQualificationGrade occurrence == 4
    )
    (fail "F4 typed source 丢失 Feature instance／family／grade／producer 局部编号")
  unless (largeDealOccurrenceRef occurrence == largeDealOccurrenceRef transportSplit) $
    fail "transport ordinal 进入了 F4 occurrence identity"
  requireCompactBson
    "DirectedLargeDeal occurrence"
    [receiptArtifactLocation f4Receipt, receiptParameterSetId f4Receipt]
    occurrence
  nextOccurrence <-
    requireRight
      "typed F4 distinct producer occurrence"
      (decodeDirectedLargeDealNumericRow f4Receipt "buy__occ0001" (Map.insert "producer_local_no" (fromIntegral (localNo + 1)) row))
  unless (largeDealOccurrenceRef occurrence /= largeDealOccurrenceRef nextOccurrence) $
    fail "不同 producer-local F4 occurrence 被错误合并"
  requireBsonRoundTrip "DirectedLargeDeal occurrence" occurrence

wallLifecycleMustBeProductSpecificAndIdempotent :: IO ()
wallLifecycleMustBeProductSpecificAndIdempotent = do
  (state, published) <- requireRight "Wall start" (applyWallOccurrenceBatch emptyWallLifecycleState [wallStart])
  unless (published == [wallStart]) $ fail "Wall state 与 public occurrence 没有原子推进"
  (sameState, duplicatePublications) <- requireRight "Wall duplicate" (applyWallOccurrenceBatch state [wallStart])
  unless (sameState == state && null duplicatePublications) $ fail "相同 Wall occurrence 重放必须幂等且不得重复公开"
  let conflict = wallStart {wallOccurrenceIdentity = otherWallIdentity}
  requireLeft "conflicting duplicate" (applyWallOccurrenceBatch state [conflict])

wallLifecycleTransitionTableMustBeComplete :: IO ()
wallLifecycleTransitionTableMustBeComplete = do
  let wallChange ref occurredAt change =
        wallStart
          { wallOccurrenceRef = OccurrenceRef ref,
            wallOccurrencePayload =
              Spine.WallLifecycleEvent
                (wallRefOf wallIdentity)
                (InstrumentSymbol "rb")
                BidWall
                occurredAt
                change
                Spine.WallLifecycleAvailable
          }
      bandUpdated = wallChange "wall-occurrence-2" 11 (Spine.WallBandUpdated measuredBand Spine.WallAlive)
      becameDormant = wallChange "wall-occurrence-3" 12 (Spine.WallPresenceChanged measuredBand Spine.WallDormant)
      becamePresent = wallChange "wall-occurrence-4" 13 (Spine.WallPresenceChanged measuredBand Spine.WallAlive)
      ended = wallChange "wall-occurrence-5" 14 (Spine.WallEnded (Spine.WallEndReason "producer-end"))
      lifecycle = [wallStart, bandUpdated, becameDormant, becamePresent, ended]
      startedDormant = wallChange "wall-occurrence-invalid-start" 10 (Spine.WallStarted measuredBand Spine.WallDormant)
      samePresent = wallChange "wall-occurrence-invalid-same-present" 11 (Spine.WallPresenceChanged measuredBand Spine.WallAlive)
      bandChangesPresence = wallChange "wall-occurrence-invalid-band-presence" 11 (Spine.WallBandUpdated measuredBand Spine.WallDormant)
      sameDormant = wallChange "wall-occurrence-invalid-same-dormant" 13 (Spine.WallPresenceChanged measuredBand Spine.WallDormant)
      dormantBandChangesPresence = wallChange "wall-occurrence-invalid-dormant-band" 13 (Spine.WallBandUpdated measuredBand Spine.WallAlive)
  (endedState, publications) <- requireRight "complete Wall transition table" (applyWallOccurrenceBatch emptyWallLifecycleState lifecycle)
  unless (publications == lifecycle) $ fail "Wall transition table 没有逐 occurrence 原子公开"
  requireLeft "Wall cannot start Dormant" (applyWallOccurrenceBatch emptyWallLifecycleState [startedDormant])
  requireLeft "Wall update before start" (applyWallOccurrenceBatch emptyWallLifecycleState [bandUpdated])
  (presentState, _) <- requireRight "Wall present state" (applyWallOccurrenceBatch emptyWallLifecycleState [wallStart])
  requireLeft "Wall same-state Present change" (applyWallOccurrenceBatch presentState [samePresent])
  requireLeft "Wall band update cannot change presence" (applyWallOccurrenceBatch presentState [bandChangesPresence])
  (dormantState, _) <- requireRight "Wall dormant state" (applyWallOccurrenceBatch presentState [becameDormant])
  requireLeft "Wall same-state Dormant change" (applyWallOccurrenceBatch dormantState [sameDormant])
  requireLeft "Wall dormant band update cannot change presence" (applyWallOccurrenceBatch dormantState [dormantBandChangesPresence])
  requireLeft "Wall update after end" (applyWallOccurrenceBatch endedState [bandUpdated {wallOccurrenceRef = OccurrenceRef "wall-occurrence-6"}])
  mapM_ (uncurry requireBsonRoundTrip) (zip ["Wall start", "Wall band update", "Wall dormant", "Wall present", "Wall end"] lifecycle)

            absorbOccurrenceKind = AbsorbConsumptionMilestoneOccurrence,
            absorbOccurrenceMilestoneLevel = Just 0.5,
            absorbOccurrencePayload =
              Spine.AbsorbInteractionEvent

  requireLeft "Absorb update after resolution" (applyAbsorbFrame absorbState [absorbMilestone {absorbOccurrenceRef = OccurrenceRef "absorb-occurrence-4"}])

            ("consumed_proxy_cum", 2),
            ("replenishment_proxy", 1),
            ("price_progress_ticks", 1)
          ]
      milestoneRow = Map.insert "level" 0.5 (Map.insert "event_type_code" 12 absorbBase)
      resolvedRow = Map.insert "resolved_type_code" 1 (Map.insert "event_type_code" 13 absorbBase)
  milestone <- requireRight "P2 Absorb milestone fixture" (decodeAbsorbNumericRow absorbReceipt wallCatalog "absorb__9" milestoneRow)
  resolved <- requireRight "P2 Absorb resolved fixture" (decodeAbsorbNumericRow absorbReceipt wallCatalog "absorb__9" resolvedRow)
  unless
    ( absorbOccurrenceKind milestone == AbsorbConsumptionMilestoneOccurrence
        && absorbOccurrenceMilestoneLevel milestone == Just 0.5
        && absorbOccurrenceResolvedReason milestone == Nothing
        && absorbOccurrenceKind resolved == AbsorbResolvedOccurrence
        && absorbOccurrenceResolvedReason resolved == Just "breakthrough"
    )
    (fail "P2 fixture 丢失 Absorb milestone level 或 resolved reason")
  (attackState, _) <-
    requireRight
      "AttackSegmentBook accepts all three product streams"
      (applyAttackFrame (emptyAttackSegmentBookState wallCatalog) [segment] [interval] [barrier])
  (sameAttackState, _) <-
    requireRight
      "AttackSegmentBook exact duplicate"
      (applyAttackFrame attackState [segment] [interval] [barrier])
  unless (sameAttackState == attackState) $ fail "AttackSegmentBook exact duplicate 不是幂等重放"
  requireLeft
    "AttackSegmentBook conflicting duplicate"
    (applyAttackFrame attackState [segment {attackOccurrenceAvailability = AttackSegmentTechnicalTruncated}] [] [])
  requireBsonRoundTrip "Wall occurrence" wallStart
  requireCompactBson "Wall occurrence" [receiptArtifactLocation wallReceipt, receiptParameterSetId wallReceipt] wallStart
  requireBsonRoundTrip "Build occurrence" buildStart
  requireCompactBson "Build occurrence" [receiptArtifactLocation buildReceipt, receiptParameterSetId buildReceipt] buildStart
  requireBsonRoundTrip "AttackSegment occurrence" segment
  requireCompactBson
    "AttackSegment occurrence"
    [ receiptArtifactLocation attackReceipt,
      receiptParameterSetId attackReceipt,
      "f4-tactical-A",
      "f4-structural-A",
      "sha256:attack-method-A"
    ]
    segment
  requireBsonRoundTrip "FormationEvidence occurrence" interval
  requireCompactBson "FormationEvidence occurrence" [receiptArtifactLocation attackReceipt, receiptParameterSetId attackReceipt] interval
  requireBsonRoundTrip "Barrier occurrence" barrier
  requireCompactBson "Barrier occurrence" [receiptArtifactLocation attackReceipt, receiptParameterSetId attackReceipt] barrier
  requireBsonRoundTrip "Absorb milestone occurrence" milestone
  requireCompactBson "Absorb milestone occurrence" [receiptArtifactLocation absorbReceipt, receiptParameterSetId absorbReceipt] milestone
  requireBsonRoundTrip "Absorb resolved occurrence" resolved

requireRight :: (Show error) => String -> Either error value -> IO value
requireRight label = either (fail . ((label <> ": ") <>) . show) pure

requireLeft :: String -> Either error value -> IO ()
requireLeft _ (Left _) = pure ()
requireLeft label (Right _) = fail (label <> " unexpectedly accepted")

requireBsonRoundTrip :: (Eq value, ToBSON value, FromBSON value) => String -> value -> IO ()
requireBsonRoundTrip label value =
  let document = toBSON value
   in unless (fromBSON document == Just value) $ fail (label <> " BSON round-trip failed: " <> show document)

requireCompactBson :: (ToBSON value) => String -> [Text.Text] -> value -> IO ()
requireCompactBson label forbidden value = do
  let rendered = Text.pack (show (toBSON value))
  unless ("compact-local-v2" `Text.isInfixOf` rendered) $
    fail (label <> " BSON 没有新 compact occurrence schema 标记")
  if any (`Text.isInfixOf` rendered) forbidden
    then fail (label <> " BSON 仍逐 occurrence 重复运行级长身份／artifact path")
    else pure ()

requirePureRight :: (Show error) => String -> Either error value -> value
requirePureRight label = either (error . ((label <> ": ") <>) . show) id
